With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Role Overview We are seeking a TPRM Senior Associate with 4+ years of relevant experience to serve as a key operational member of the London TPRM team. This role is the primary operational bridge between the London leadership, the Offshore TPRM Operations Team, and critical onshore functions (Procurement, Business Owners, Risk SMEs). The Senior Associate is responsible for coordinating the execution workflow, managing the quality assurance of medium-risk third parties, and driving the logistics for the critical Supplier Performance Review process. Responsibilities This role is centred on execution quality, operational leadership, and cross-functional coordination within the London TPRM team structure: Offshore Operations Liaison & Quality Control: Act as the primary daily point of contact and operational supervisor for the Offshore TPRM Operations Team , ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all third-party risk assessments and due diligence activities. Lead the Quality Control (QC) process for all assessments delivered by the offshore team, ensuring outputs are consistent, align with established methodologies, and are fully audit-ready. Monitor the operational performance of the offshore team against defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Be ready to conduct third-party assessments to support the team, where required. Stakeholder Coordination & Assessment Oversight: Coordinate Assessment Initiation by working closely with Procurement and Business Owners to ensure third-party risk assessments are initiated at the correct phase of the third-party lifecycle. Manage the crucial triage and review process by coordinating with Internal Risk SMEs (e.g., InfoSec, Data Privacy, BCP) to ensure high-risk assessments receive appropriate specialized review and sign-off prior to completion. Serve as the operational point of contact for these onshore internal risk teams regarding third-party -specific findings and remediation requirements. Supplier Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Oversee the governance and standardization of ongoing supplier performance monitoring activities executed by the offshore team. Coordinate with Business Owners and Procurement to collect and review performance data (e.g., SLA adherence, operational metrics) and integrate significant performance failures or deficiencies into the overall third-party risk profile. Ensure any critical performance issues are appropriately flagged for risk review and incorporated into continuous monitoring plans. Escalation and Remediation Management: Serve as the primary escalation point for all high-risk findings, process bottlenecks, and third-party non-compliance issues reported by the Offshore TPRM Operations Team . Work with Business Owners and Procurement to define, drive, and track third-party remediation plans, ensuring mitigation steps are completed within established timelines. 2nd Line of Defense Liaison & Governance Support: Act as the key operational liaison for the 2nd Line of Defense (Risk Oversight) , compiling and delivering required operational data, metrics, and commentary on the coverage and control effectiveness of the TPRM program. data.title: Senior eCommerce Content Strategist
data.description: About Us Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms. Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development. The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C. The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption. A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms. The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility. Tasks What You’ll Be Doing Content Audits & Quality Assessment ● Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short. ● Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. ● Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy. Content Strategy Development ● Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus. ● Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour. ● Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category. ● Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on. ● Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction. AI & Agentic Discoverability ● AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search. ● Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations. ● Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery. Testing & Performance Monitoring ● A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent. ● Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation. ● Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy. Creative Briefing & Review ● Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and marketplace advertising content. ● Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction. ● Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery. Client Management ● Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders. ● Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams. ● Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements. ● Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice. ● Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business. Quality & Output Review ● Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements. ● Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy. AI-Enabled Working ● AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy. ● Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team. Requirements What You Bring to the Role ● Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment. ● Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C. ● Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards. ● Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy. ● Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers. ● Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results. ● Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this. ● Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals. ● Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats. ● Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle. ● Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance. ● Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers. Desirable ● Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms. ● Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive. ● Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals. ● Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base. Benefits What We Offer ● Competitive salary and benefits ● Hybrid Working Model ● Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team ● Continuous learning & career development ● The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. data.title: Senior Finance Officer
data.description: Role: Senior Finance Officer Location: DFYNE HQ, 1 Forrest Gate, Uddingston, G71 5PG Work Location: Onsite About You: Are you someone who loves getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger financial picture? Do you enjoy turning numbers into meaningful insight, spotting trends, strengthening controls, and ensuring everything balances exactly as it should? Are you equally comfortable preparing management accounts, analysing variances, managing fixed assets, and rolling up your sleeves to process invoices and reconcile supplier accounts? If you're highly organised, commercially aware, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, DFYNE may be the place for you. About DFYNE: A picture paints a thousand words… and we’re sure you don’t want to be sat here reading an essay of corporate “about us” spiel…. Seriously, how’re you able to really get under the skin of what we’re about from a few words on a screen. So why don’t you have a look and see what we’re all about for yourself - www.dfyne.com. About the role - DFYNE Your Career: First off, it's best I introduce myself (person behind the keyboard here). It’s not the norm on a job advert, but I think it’s important you get introduced to who you might be working with for a long time early on. I'm Luca, Chief Financial Officer at DFYNE, and I'm looking for someone who can help us continue building a world-class finance function as we scale globally. This isn't a traditional management accountant role where you'll only focus on month-end reporting from a distance. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of accurate and timely management accounts while remaining hands-on across accounts payable, fixed asset management, lease accounting, financial controls, and commercial analysis. You'll be responsible for ensuring financial information is reliable, insightful, and delivered on time, whilst maintaining strong processes that keep the day-to-day finance operation running smoothly. You'll partner with teams across the business, challenge costs where appropriate, identify risks and opportunities, and support the continued growth of DFYNE through sound financial management. Attitude: Ownership mentality Detail obsessed Commercially curious Problem solver Calm under pressure Continuous improvement mindset Key Responsibilities 1. Management Accounts & Month-End Reporting: Prepare monthly management accounts, including profit and loss, balance sheet, and supporting schedules, to agreed deadlines. Post and review accruals, prepayments, depreciation, amortisation, and other month-end journals; maintain clear supporting working papers. Complete and review balance sheet reconciliations, investigate differences, and resolve outstanding items. Analyse actual results against budget, forecast, and prior periods, explaining material variances and cost trends to management. Support budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning, and improvements to management reporting. Ensure accurate cut-off, allocation of costs to departments and cost centres, and completeness of month-end liabilities. Work with the Finance Team Lead on audit preparation, financial controls, and process improvements. 2. Fixed Assets & Right-of-Use (ROU) Asset Accounting: Maintain and reconcile the Fixed Asset Register (FAR), ensuring accurate accounting for capital expenditure (CapEx), additions, disposals, and depreciation calculations. Manage Right-of-Use (ROU) asset schedules and lease liabilities in accordance with relevant accounting standards (IFRS 16 / FRS 102), ensuring monthly lease interest and depreciation journals are accurately posted. Review purchase invoices and CapEx requests to ensure correct capitalisation treatment versus operational expense (OpEx). Perform periodic physical asset verifications/audits and reconcile asset register balances to general ledger control accounts. Prepare lease schedules, impairment reviews, and disclosures for month-end and year-end statutory audit reporting. 3. Daily Finance Inbox & Invoice Control: Manage and clear the finance inbox daily, with visible Processed/Actioned and pending categories to support seamless handovers. Register 100% of incoming invoices in NetSuite within two working days and maintain visibility of future payment liabilities. Verify supplier invoice details, dates, values, and UK VAT treatment; accurately code invoices to general ledger accounts and cost centres. Assess expenditure for value for money; query unexpected charges with department heads and place unresolved invoices on hold. 4. Reconciliations & Financial Control: Regularly review and cleanse the accounts payable ledger, resolving aged balances, unapplied payments, and debit notes. Reconcile supplier statements, the AP sub-ledger, fixed asset registers, lease schedules, and the general ledger before month-end close. Keep AP postings aligned with bank payment schedules and investigate discrepancies promptly. Maintain accurate, audit-ready records and comply with applicable HMRC VAT and record-keeping requirements. 5. Specialist Logistics Accounting: Process outbound shipping invoices weekly, clearing relevant inbox items before posting; post matching journals on the same day for accurate cost-centre reporting. Register returns logistics invoices on receipt, complete checks using the available checker, and post required journals. Experience Needed: AAT-qualified, part-qualified ACCA/CIMA, or qualified by experience with substantial relevant responsibility. Demonstrable hands-on experience preparing monthly management accounts and completing month-end close. Practical experience in maintaining fixed asset registers, calculating depreciation, and managing capital expenditure accounting. Strong practical accounts payable experience, including high-volume invoices, supplier reconciliations, and payment runs. Experience with NetSuite or a comparable cloud ERP; sound Excel skills for reconciliations and reporting. Skills: Understanding of lease accounting principles and Right-of-Use (ROU) asset management under IFRS 16 or FRS 102. Confident with journals, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and variance analysis. Good understanding of UK VAT, HMRC documentation requirements, general ledger coding, and financial controls. Organised, accurate, and commercially aware; comfortable challenging costs and working independently to deadlines. Able to communicate effectively with department heads, suppliers, and senior finance colleagues. So, what’s in it for you?: If you’ve made it this far down without being put off, brilliant, I’d love to hear from you. Besides a work family and a great place to work, you’ll have an opportunity to grow with the company, be a part of the journey, and have a vital input into helping continue the crazy growth we’ve already seen. You’ll be part of a high challenge, high reward culture. Salary: Starting from £52,430 annually. data.description: Global Solutions Architect - Cloud About the role Rubrik Professional Services is hiring a Global Solutions Architect to serve as our most senior technical authority for public cloud. This is a global, individual-contributor role at Technical Director level. You will set the architectural direction for how Rubrik is designed, deployed, and operated in the world’s most demanding cloud environments, and you will carry that direction personally into our most strategic customer engagements. You will be deployed where technical risk is highest: flagship accounts, first-of-a-kind architectures, and the engagements whose outcome sets the pattern everyone else follows. Between those engagements, you will convert what you learned into the reference architectures, service offerings, and enablement that raise the capability of every architect and consultant in the field. Your impact is measured by the quality of the practice you leave behind, not the hours you personally bill. We are looking for depth in public cloud architecture first. Deep Rubrik product expertise is expected to be built on the job. data.description: Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic! About Tailscale Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital. About the Role We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer, AI Enablement to help Tailscale's engineering organization get the most out of AI-assisted development. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools. Key Responsibilities Partner with engineering leadership and Tailscale's technical staff to define and drive our internal AI-enablement roadmap. Work closely with the team building Aperture by Tailscale, our AI gateway used both internally and offered as a product. Build and iterate on the tools, workflows, and shared practices that help engineers get real value from coding agents — and evaluate new models and tools, making clear calls on what we adopt. Partner with engineering and non-engineering teams to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI — this is a support function, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built. Establish the guardrails, review practices, and documentation that make AI-generated code safe to ship, and act as the internal advocate who helps teams adopt good practices without mandating a single tool. Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on velocity and quality, and report back to leadership. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate. Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap Nice to Have Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python Background in security or code-review practices — helpful for reasoning about AI/agent-generated code, though you don't need to be a security engineer Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption Technical project management experience As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles). Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family! Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. data.description: We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we believe in the power of data to create better software and exceptional digital experiences and our cloud partners are right at the heart of how we scale that vision globally . As our Senior Cloud Partner Sales Manager , you won't just be managing partnerships; you will act as a pivotal growth engine . You will bridge the gap between our internal sales leadership and our cloud partner counterparts at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure . If you want the autonomy to build deep network relationships, align go-to-market strategies, and accelerate high-velocity co-sell motions that directly influence pipeline revenue, this is the place to do it . data.title: People Operations Partner
data.description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. 🚀 The Role We're hiring a People Operations Partner to join our Performance team. tem is rebuilding the energy transaction - transparent, fair and built on trust. Behind that mission is a company growing fast, and a Performance team that's already lean and stretched. Core People operations needs more firepower as we scale, and there's a direct commercial angle too: a strong People Operations function is what lets new joiners ramp up and become productive faster once they arrive. This is a multi-disciplinary People Operations role at the centre of the employee lifecycle - equal parts operational delivery, automation and continuous improvement. You'll be the reliable hands keeping People processes running as we scale, from multi-country payroll to onboarding, employee changes and offboarding. You'll also build the tools, automations and lightweight AI workflows that connect our systems (Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n and Google Workspace), so the function doesn't need to double in size every time headcount does. In your first 12 months, you might: Take ownership of payroll across our UK and employer-of-record employees, keeping every cycle accurate and on time as pay schedules and countries multiply. Become the trusted point of contact for employees and managers, owning their queries through to resolution. Build the automations and AI-enabled workflows that remove repetitive manual work from the employee lifecycle. Turn recurring pain points into better processes, tools or self-service, and measure whether they actually worked. Move across People disciplines as priorities shift - reward and benchmarking, pensions and options administration, performance cycles, engagement and people data. 🛠️ Responsibilities Run payroll end to end: own monthly payroll across UK and employer-of-record employees - changes, corrections, off-cycle and ex-gratia payments, contractor payroll and invoicing, and country-specific items - keeping it accurate and on time as we add pay schedules and countries. Keep the lifecycle running: deliver core People operations across onboarding, employee changes, contracts and documentation, leave, mobility (visas and international moves), EOR and contractor setup, and offboarding, flexing into whatever the business needs most. Be the trusted point of contact: own employee and manager queries through to resolution with a clear response standard, rather than passing them between functions. Keep the foundations accurate: maintain employee data, documentation and systems so that everything else can depend on them. Automate the repeatable: build and maintain automations and lightweight AI-enabled tools, workflows and agents that connect Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n, Google Workspace and similar, and remove repetitive manual work - with controls so speed never costs accuracy, privacy or employee trust. Own the People tech stack: evolve our People technology ecosystem - evaluate emerging tools, consolidate where we can, and simplify the architecture. Improve continuously: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, measure whether they worked, and give foundational People processes a named owner and a runbook someone else could follow cold. Design to delight and to scale: we treat our people like top athletes and aim to delight at every step of the employee journey, and what works at today's size shouldn't need twice the People team when headcount doubles - default to eliminating or automating work rather than administering it. Partner across the business: work with Finance, Legal, Talent, Performance Partners and functional specialists to turn People initiatives into scalable services, and build dashboards and lightweight analysis that help the team and the business make better decisions. ✅ Requirements Must-Haves You've worked in People Operations, People Services, HR Operations or another operational People role - generalists welcome - and you hold a high bar on accuracy and confidentiality. You've run payroll cycles end to end, ideally multi-country, in-house or through an employer of record. UK fundamentals (PAYE, RTI, pension auto-enrolment, statutory payments) are familiar, or clearly learnable fast if your payroll experience comes from another market. You're highly comfortable with technology: AI is part of how you work, you actively experiment with new tools and capabilities, and you can build automations through no-code or low-code tools, integrations and AI workflows. You think in systems and workflows rather than individual tasks, with a strong instinct for simplification ("why are we doing this manually?"), and you're comfortable using data to diagnose problems and make decisions. You operate effectively in ambiguity, without waiting for a perfectly defined process or remit, and you balance efficiency with empathy - People Operations is about people, not just workflows. Strong ownership instincts: when something's broken, unclear or inefficient, your instinct is to fix it, and you're willing to move across People disciplines depending on where the organisation needs you. Desirable Breadth across the People remit beyond Operations - reward and benchmarking, pensions, benefits, or performance and engagement. This role is deliberately multi-disciplinary. Familiarity with the basics of UK and EU employment law, and experience administering equity or share options (for example EMI or unapproved schemes, and cap-table tools such as Vestd). Experience supporting international employment through employers of record, and setting up or managing contractors (including off-payroll and IR35 awareness). Experience in a fast-scaling startup or scale-up, especially through a period of doubling headcount or entering new countries. 🎁 Benefits & Perks Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing. 🤝 Interview Process We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know. Intro call with our Talent team. Hiring Manager interview. Skills interview, which might include a practical exercise. Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. data.title: Engineering Manager, Experiment Platform, Robot Software
data.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model. The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software. 🧠 Your day-to-day You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. You will maintain the team’s mission, charter and twelve-month roadmap, turn them into quarterly and six-week plans, and keep delivery on track. You will be the team’s main point of contact for partner engineering teams, programme managers, operations and OEM customers, and you will make it clear what the team owns. You will stay technically capable and aware of the team’s work across the codebase. You will monitor the architecture, guide the team through technical blockers when needed, and engage with technical leaders in other teams at a technical level. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Growing the platform: Take the development platform from its first stable release to a product used across many vehicle types, with predictable releases and validation in CI and on HIL benches. Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration. Self-serve experimentation: Make the platform self-serve, so research teams can run their own experiments on vehicles without waiting for platform changes. Scaling data collection: Onboard and event-based logging, data quality, and data offload over New vehicles and OEM integrations: Deploy the full platform on Wayve’s next-generation vehicles, and support new OEM integrations through configuration rather than new releases. Building the operating model around the platform: Releases, support rota, on-call, metrics and observability. Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, and grow the team as adoption of the platform expands. 🙌 You should apply if: You have managed software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching and performance management. You have owned a platform or product that other teams or customers relied on, and shipped it to devices in the field. You are technically capable, with hands-on experience in embedded Linux systems software (C++ or Python), and stay close enough to the code to review your team’s work, guide architecture and help resolve technical blockers. You understand connected device fleets, such as vehicles, robots or IoT, including data logging and offload, over-the-air updates and observability. You are comfortable leading delivery across many stakeholders, including external partners, and can engage with other technical leaders as a technical peer. You care about operational reliability and release quality. Experience with autonomous vehicles or robotics, automotive ECUs (for example NVIDIA Jetson or DRIVE, QNX), Yocto, IPC middleware such as ROS 2 or DDS, or containerised workloads on embedded systems is desirable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. This role is based in our London office. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews : leadership and management interview, and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total Deep-dive interviews : domain, systems design and code review interviews; 3 hours total Final interview : values alignment (30-45 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. data.description: Your Mission About the Role We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Bid Manager to lead and project manage the end-to-end tender and proposal process across our UK business. You will take ownership of each bid from early qualification and planning through to submission, clarification, handover and post-bid review. This includes setting the bid strategy, defining responsibilities, coordinating contributors, managing timelines and dependencies, and ensuring that decisions and deliverables are completed to the required quality and deadline. The role requires someone who can bring structure and momentum to complex tender processes, engage stakeholders across different functions and levels, and constructively challenge assumptions, contributions and proposed solutions. Working closely with Commercial, Operations, Delivery, Product, Legal, Finance and central teams, you will ensure that submissions are compliant, compelling, deliverable and commercially robust. Key Responsibilities Own and manage the full bid lifecycle from opportunity qualification and bid planning through to submission, clarification, contract handover and post-bid review. Develop and maintain clear bid plans covering deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, review stages, approvals, resources and deadlines. Lead bid kick-offs, progress reviews, solution workshops and final submission reviews, creating clarity and accountability across all contributors. Coordinate and actively manage internal stakeholders, external consultants and specialist partners, challenging delays, unclear ownership or insufficient contributions. Identify bid risks, dependencies, gaps and decision requirements early, escalating where necessary to protect quality, commercial viability and timelines. Lead bid qualification and go/no-go assessments, ensuring that client requirements and commercial, technical, operational and delivery implications are fully understood. Develop the bid strategy, win themes, key messages and overall proposal structure in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. Ensure that submissions are compliant, persuasive, commercially competitive and operationally deliverable, constructively challenging assumptions and proposed commitments. Own the overall quality and consistency of proposal content, turning cross-functional input into one clear, client-focused response. Maintain an accurate tender pipeline and clear reporting on opportunity status, key dates, resource requirements, risks and decisions. Improve bid-management tools, governance and reusable content, including Jira-based planning and appropriate use of AI-supported bidding solutions. Ensure a structured handover of successful bids, including commitments, assumptions, risks, dependencies, SLAs and implementation obligations, to Delivery and Operations. Your profile What We're Looking For Proven experience leading complex bids, proposals or tender processes from qualification through to submission and handover. Strong project-management skills, including planning, stakeholder coordination, risk management, governance and action tracking. Confidence coordinating and constructively challenging contributors across different functions and levels of seniority. Ability to create accountability and maintain momentum without relying on formal authority. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex input into clear and persuasive proposals. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to understand client priorities, operational constraints and business risks. Ability to identify gaps, dependencies and unrealistic commitments early and drive timely decisions. Highly organised and comfortable managing several concurrent deadlines and changing priorities. Experience with public-sector procurement, framework agreements or infrastructure tenders would be highly advantageous. Experience in EV charging, energy, transport, mobility, utilities or related infrastructure, and familiarity with Jira, CRM or proposal-management tools, would be beneficial. data.description: Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle. Sales Director, EMEA This is a senior sales opportunity for an experienced commercial leader to drive Talos’s growth with banks and TradFi institutions as institutional finance moves into digital assets and tokenized, multi-asset trading. As Sales Director at Talos, you will own new business and key relationships across the UK, with a focus on banks and TradFi institutions entering digital assets. You will run the full deal lifecycle, from origination and discovery through solutioning, trials and close, partnering closely with Solutions and Account Management to make sure clients are set up for long-term success. Talos runs a structured, consultative sales environment. This role suits someone with an established TradFi network, a proven record of originating revenue, and the ability to clearly articulate how institutional trading infrastructure is changing. Responsibilities Originate and close new business across banks, broker-dealers and TradFi institutions, alongside Talos’s core client segments including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers and digital asset service providers. Use and expand your network of senior bank and TradFi relationships to build a high-quality pipeline from day one. Lead senior-level discovery and demo conversations, mapping institutional workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities. Position Talos clearly within the evolving digital asset ecosystem, translating TradFi requirements across connectivity, risk, compliance and workflow into Talos’s value proposition. Manage and grow an existing book of business in partnership with Account Management, driving retention, expansion and executive-level relationships. Coordinate cross-functionally with Solutions, Account Management, Product and Engineering to advance deals and make sure client commitments are accurate and deliverable. Act as a senior Talos presence in the London market, representing Talos at industry conferences and client events. Share expertise and informally mentor junior members of the sales team. An established network of active relationships across banks and TradFi institutions, particularly in the UK and Europe. data.title: Research Scientist, Protein Design & Engineering
data.description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK. The role You'll engineer proteins to carry out useful chemistry, combining enzyme discovery, directed evolution, and experimental characterisation. You'll own the experimental cycle: choosing starting points, building variant libraries, developing screens, and establishing which changes improve function and why. This is a hands-on role working closely with our computational and ML teams. You'll test designed proteins at the bench, use experimental results to guide subsequent rounds, and develop enzymes with the activity, selectivity, and stability needed for their intended application. There’s no fixed screening pipeline to inherit — you'll help decide how we build it. What you'll do Design and run protein engineering campaigns, from initial enzyme selection and library design through screening and characterisation of improved variants. Build and express variant libraries using site-directed, random, and combinatorial mutagenesis. Develop assays and high-throughput screens that reliably measure the properties we're trying to improve. Express, purify, and characterise proteins, measuring kinetics, substrate scope, selectivity, and stability under relevant reaction conditions. Work with computational scientists to test proposed designs, interpret successes and failures, and use the results to guide the next round. Develop enzymatic reactions and cascades, identifying how enzyme performance, cofactors, and reaction conditions affect overall productivity. Essential experience We're interested in the engineering campaigns you've run, the assays you've built, and what you learned from them. We care about: A track record of improving protein or enzyme function through directed evolution or rational engineering. Practical fluency in molecular biology, including cloning, library construction, mutagenesis, and recombinant protein expression. Experience developing and troubleshooting enzyme assays and screening workflows, with appropriate controls and follow-up validation. A solid grasp of enzyme mechanism, kinetics, and structure–function relationships, and the ability to use these to guide experiments. Experience independently taking projects through multiple design–build–test cycles and explaining what drove the results. Highly preferred Experience with industrial biocatalysis or engineering enzymes for demanding reaction conditions. Experience integrating liquid handling and laboratory automation with high-throughput screening. Familiarity with biosensor-based screens, growth-based selection, or FACS. Experience testing computationally designed proteins and feeding experimental results back into design. Experience with enzyme cascades, fermentation, or transferring enzymatic processes from the bench to larger scales. Logistics This is a full-time, on-site role in Cambridge, MA. Compensation is highly competitive. We're also able to sponsor visas for the right candidate. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

data.title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
data.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Pourquoi Deliveroo ? Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes. Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires. Descriptif du poste : En tant qu'Apprenti(e) dans l'équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing tels que l'équipe média, l'équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu'avec l' équipe commerciale. Vos missions consisteront à: Mettre en avant sur l'application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l'app. Soutenir l'équipe commerciale dans la création et l'exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo. Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations). Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté. Contribuer à l'exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l'application / notifications push...). Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal. Analyser l'impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles. Ce qui vous permettra de réussir Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027. Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs. Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance. Voici un lien avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens. Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante ! La vie chez Deliveroo : Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix. Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel. data.description: Brief info about Vinted Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. Information about the position Vinted Go grows by signing new pick-up/drop-off locations, and a large share of that growth is delivered by external sales agencies. You will own that network: the agencies running our field sales, virtual calling and digital outreach across Europe and the US. Today these relationships are managed in a fragmented way. You will act as an agency manager, performance analyst and budget owner, and above all as the guardian of the Vinted Go sales approach in every conversation an agency has on our behalf. data.title: Supply Planner
data.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a Supply Planner, your role is crucial in optimising the flow of materials from suppliers into our operations. You function as the primary analytical link between strategic purchasing decisions and operational inventory needs. Your main mission is to ensure optimal stock availability (raw materials, components) while driving cost efficiency and minimising risks of shortages or obsolescence. You actively collaborate with the Procurement team to integrate market insights into tangible planning actions. Responsibilities Operational Planning and Procurement Strategy Support Demand Translation: Analyze sales forecasts and production schedules to accurately determine raw material and component requirements (MRP/DRP). Supplier Ordering: Generate, send, and monitor purchase orders (POs) based on planning requirements, ensuring alignment with procurement contracts and volume agreements. Inventory Optimization: Define, monitor, and adjust planning parameters (safety stock, reorder points, EOQ) in the ERP to maintain target inventory levels and reduce working capital. Supplier Performance and Risk Management OTD Monitoring: Track and report on supplier performance metrics (On Time Delivery - OTD, lead time compliance) and proactively highlight potential delivery risks to the Procurement Manager. Risk Analysis: Identify and anticipate potential supply disruptions (e.g., transport delays, capacity issues) and develop mitigation plans in collaboration with the Purchasing team. data.description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. The Role As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack. This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production. What You Will Do Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses. Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss. Collaborate with the Inference Foundation team to integrate validated techniques into the vLLM-based serving stack. Partner with pretraining and RL teams when techniques require co-training, retraining, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. Build the right tooling and validation platforms to facilitate AI-driven inference research. What We're Looking For A strong ML background with solid knowledge of LLM training techniques — architecture, tokenization, fine-tuning, and evaluation. Hands-on experience with Python and PyTorch; you write clean, experimental code and iterate fast. JAX is acceptable with strong Python proficiency. C++ and Rust are not required, CUDA and GPU knowledge is expected but hands-on experience is not required. Research experience of some form: a thesis, publications, a dedicated research project, or efficiency-oriented work in a lab or industry research setting. A PhD is not required, but we are looking for genuine research depth. A track record of conducting experiments: forming hypotheses, designing controlled comparisons, and drawing clear conclusions from results. Familiarity with the state of the art in LLM inference — you know what has been tried, what works, and where the open problems are. Self-starter, low-ego, and collaborative. You are comfortable with ambiguity, negative results, and are eager to take matters into your own hands. Inference or serving experience is a plus, not a requirement. Prior work with vLLM, production LLM deployments, or serving systems will help you ramp up faster. Location and Remote This role is based in our Paris or London offices (hybrid). Votre objectif Votre rôle consistera à veiller au bon fonctionnement de la plateforme EDI, résoudre les problèmes techniques et participer à son évolution. Vous interviendrez sur la supervision des flux EDI, la résolution des incidents et l’intégration de nouveaux clients et partenaires, tout en apportant des solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins rencontrés. Vous participerez également à l’évolution des outils internes, notamment à travers l’intégration de nouvelles fonctionnalités liées à l’intelligence artificielle. L’équipe que vous rejoignez Vous intégrerez une entreprise à taille humaine, dont une équipe EDI. Vous évoluerez au contact de profils techniques expérimentés, dans un environnement où la qualité de service, la réactivité et la proximité avec les clients occupent une place importante. Une formation en immersion avec un chef de projet est prévue pour vous familiariser avec les standards EDI, les protocoles et les outils internes. Ce que vous ferez concrètement Au quotidien, vous interviendrez principalement sur : Assurer l’exploitation, la supervision et la maintenance opérationnelle de la plateforme EDI. Analyser et résoudre les incidents techniques signalés par les outils de supervision ou les clients. Configurer et maintenir les échanges de données entre les différents systèmes informatiques. Intégrer de nouveaux clients et partenaires en mettant en place les connexions et les flux EDI. Intervenir sur les applications et les scripts nécessaires au traitement et à la transmission des données. Assurer le support technique auprès des clients. Vous pourrez également contribuer à : Participer à l’évolution des applications et des outils internes. Contribuer à l’intégration de fonctionnalités d’intelligence artificielle dans les solutions existantes. Améliorer les traitements et les processus d’échanges de données. Participer à la résolution de problématiques liées aux réseaux, aux systèmes et à la sécurisation des échanges. Votre environnement technique Pour être rapidement à l’aise sur le poste, une connaissance opérationnelle des échanges EDI, notamment du standard EDIFACT, ainsi qu’une bonne maîtrise des environnements Linux sont attendues. Vous pourrez notamment évoluer avec : EDI / EDIFACT : standards et formats d’échanges de données. Linux / Shell / Bash : administration, scripting et automatisation. PHP : développement et maintenance applicative. SQL : manipulation et exploitation des bases de données. OFTP / OFTP2 / AS2 / X400 / SFTP : protocoles de communication et de transmission. XML / XSLT : traitement et transformation des données. De bonnes connaissances en réseaux informatiques, systèmes et cryptographie vous permettront d’avoir une compréhension globale des échanges et de leur sécurisation., Vous rejoindrez un environnement où vous pourrez développer vos compétences sur différentes technologies et évoluer progressivement vers davantage de responsabilités techniques. Votre profil Vous disposez d’au moins 1 an d’expérience professionnelle, idéalement dans l’exploitation, l’intégration ou l’administration de systèmes EDI. Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des flux EDI et des messages au format EDIFACT, et vous comprenez les problématiques liées à leur traitement, leur transmission et leur supervision. Vous maîtrisez les environnements Linux et Shell/Bash, possédez des connaissances en PHP et êtes à l’aise avec les bases de données SQL. Une expérience dans le support applicatif, la résolution d’incidents ou l’intégration de nouveaux flux de données sera particulièrement pertinente. Une connaissance des protocoles de communication EDI et des technologies XML / XSLT constituera un atout supplémentaire. Vous disposez également d’un bon niveau de communication en français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, ainsi que d’un anglais professionnel. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
data.description: 📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques. Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer . Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse , vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites. Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique . Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance . Vos missions Votre rôle Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite . Vous êtes à la fois : un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ; un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ; un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents. Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre. Vos principales missions 1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels. Votre périmètre couvre notamment : les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ; les systèmes de secours électrique ; les UPS / onduleurs ; les groupes électrogènes ; les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ; les systèmes de refroidissement ; la protection et la sécurité incendie ; les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées. Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations , et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques. 2 - Sécuriser les opérations L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques. À ce titre, vous : challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ; vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ; identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ; sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ; challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ; pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ; accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ; contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification. Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation , avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service. 3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites. Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels . Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : structurer les processus d'exploitation ; définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ; rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ; mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ; contrôler leur bonne application ; identifier les écarts entre les sites ; proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ; partager les bonnes pratiques ; réaliser des REX multisites ; accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards. La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique. 4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations. Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à : analyser techniquement l'incident ; identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ; apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ; challenger les analyses proposées ; accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ; contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ; participer à la résolution de l'incident ; organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites. Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle. 5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation. Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à : former et accompagner les équipes ; expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ; faire progresser les pratiques ; fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ; accompagner la conduite du changement ; favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites. Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct . 6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs Vous serez capable de : représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ; expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ; présenter les actions mises en œuvre ; répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ; apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures. Une organisation en construction Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré , regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets. L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation. Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec : les responsables de site ; les équipes Facility et Operations ; les équipes projets ; les experts techniques ; les prestataires et partenaires externes ; les fonctions transverses ; les clients majeurs. Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes . Vos compétences Votre profil Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée . Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées. Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée. Votre expertise technique Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment : électricité HT/BT ; systèmes de secours électrique ; UPS / groupes électrogènes ; CVC / HVAC ; refroidissement ; protection incendie ; contrôle-commande ; maintenance des infrastructures critiques. Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes , et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial. Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées. Votre expérience opérationnelle Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante. Vous êtes à l'aise avec : les modes opératoires (MOP) ; la gestion des changements ; l'analyse de risques ; la maintenance préventive et corrective ; la gestion d'incidents critiques ; les audits et contrôles opérationnels ; les REX ; la standardisation des pratiques ; la gestion de prestataires techniques. Vous avez surtout envie de faire progresser une organisation , de structurer les pratiques et d'améliorer durablement les opérations. Vos qualités Pour réussir dans ce rôle, nous recherchons une personne : dotée d'une forte expertise technique ; structurée et rigoureuse ; capable d'analyse et de prise de recul ; pédagogue et capable de transmettre son expertise ; à l'aise pour challenger ses interlocuteurs ; capable de prendre des décisions et de défendre une position technique ; dotée d'une forte intelligence relationnelle ; capable de s'adapter à différents profils et différents niveaux de maturité ; fédératrice et à l'aise dans un rôle transverse ; capable d'accompagner la conduite du changement. Votre capacité à adapter votre communication à votre interlocuteur tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence technique sera déterminante.
