data.description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description We are looking for a driven, autonomous and impactful Staff Engineer to join the Billing Squad within our StoreFront department . The Billing squad is one of the most cross-functional and fastest growing development teams within Sonar. We enable the release of all the new products that Sonar is currently bringing to the market, both for large and small customers. The AI-native, usage-based nature of our product offering is pushing us to rethink how we develop and implement innovative pricing models. This is pushing us to our limits every day! You will partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and other Staff/Principal Engineers across the organization to lead the end-to-end delivery of critical billing features. You will take ownership—from initial architecture and design through to implementation and deployment—of major initiatives ensuring a frictionless yet highly secure experience for millions of developers. What you will do Collaborate with UX designers, Product Management, and engineering teams to deliver robust security features alongside an optimal user experience. Work cross functionally with product squads and go-to-market teams to ensure smooth release of new features and products. Take strong ownership of squad deliverables and effectively drive sprints toward successful completion. Architect and guide the design of our on-premises and AWS cloud applications. Oversee feature deployment, production monitoring, and troubleshoot team-specific live issues. Mentor engineering team members to help them grow in their technical responsibilities and remove blockers to their autonomy. Contribute to the definition of the team’s short and long-term goals. Experience and qualifications Over 6 years of software engineering experience, including working as a Tech Lead, Staff Engineer, or Software Architect. Proven ability to take initiative and bring a subject involving several stakeholders and engineers to completion with little to no supervision. Proficiency in working with and steering AI coding tools (Codex, Claude, etc). Experience supporting and mentoring other team members. Proficiency with Java coupled with a strong passion for Clean Code and rigorous software quality standards. Experience architecting cloud-native applications. Experience with relational RDBMS (such as Postgres) and SQL. Domain expertise with billing and payment processing systems (we use Stripe) and/or general experience with subscription management is highly desirable. In-office culture We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person. data.title: English to German (Switzerland) Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
data.description: About Welo Global Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com The Role We are seeking an experienced English into German (Switzerland) Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. Project Details - Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below) - Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month - Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract - Task type: Language Lead Support - Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support - Language pair: English into German from Switzerland What You Will Do -Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down. -Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes. -Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data. -Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager. -Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time. What You Will Own -The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance -The community’s shared understanding of quality -The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced -The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking Requirements - Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles - Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution - Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping - Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI) - Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting - Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements - Language: Native-level German (Switzerland) and professional-level English - Preferred: Prior e xperience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools Additional Key Information - Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work. - A background check is required as part of onboarding. - Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries. Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam. data.title: Junior Business Data Analyst
data.description: PIX4D is seeking a talented Business Data Analyst to bridge Finance, Product Management and Commercial Operations (Sales and Marketing), develop complex analytical tools to drive strategic decisions and optimize processes. You will be a member of PIX4D’s dynamic Finance team, in a hybrid work environment, based in Lausanne, Switzerland. In this cross-functional role, you will query complex datasets, build dashboards, define KPIs, and translate emerging trends into actionable insights for stakeholders. You will balance data integrity with commercial impact, transforming raw data into insights that support high-level strategic decisions. Responsibilities Data Analysis & Reporting: Cleaning, manipulating, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies. Dashboard Development: Creating interactive dashboards and reports using dashboarding tools and leveraging AI-powered tools for enhanced automation and visualization. AI & Automation: Leveraging Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to streamline data workflows and enhance intelligent decision-making. Database Querying: Using SQL to extract and prepare data from various systems. Actionable Insights: Translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for business growth, efficiency, and optimization. Stakeholder Collaboration: Working with cross-functional teams to define business requirements and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Data Governance: Ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and standardization. Requirements Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Excel (advanced), and experience using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker). AI Proficiency: Familiarity with Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations. Analytical Abilities: Strong statistical knowledge, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. Communication: Ability to tell a story with data to non-technical stakeholders. Education/Experience: A master’s degree in business, economics, statistics, or data analytics, coupled with a first experience in supporting data-driven decisions. What we offer Exciting work with cutting-edge technology in an international company. Well-located office near Lausanne, with easy access by public transport. Flexible working hours and hybrid work possibility. 25 days of paid vacation. Employee Assistance Program with Lyra providing Mental, Legal and Financial assistance. Contribution to some events: Bike to Work (the biggest health and cycling promotion campaign in Switzerland), Lausanne Triathlon. Discounts for local stores, restaurants and other services. Company Social Events. Learning and professional development opportunities. Working environment PIX4D is a unique, fun, and intellectually stimulating company where you can grow and excel in your field. Our environment is authentic and multicultural, a place where we respect and learn from each other in the pursuit of being the best at what we do. Get more information here . Recruitment PIX4D promotes diversity and offers opportunities across all levels and career paths in all of its offices regardless of gender, race, or religion. We use standardized and structured interviews to ensure all candidates are treated equally and avoid any discrimination. Company When you work at PIX4D, you empower professionals worldwide to digitize reality through survey-grade georeferenced 2D maps and 3D models. These outputs can be measured, analyzed, and shared, all based on data from images taken by plane, drone, or mobile phone. We build solutions that take advantage of technology including reality capture, computer vision, digital twins, and machine learning to help solve our customers' most complex challenges. Founded in 2011, PIX4D has its headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland and commercial and R&D offices in Denver, Berlin, Tokyo, Bucharest and Madrid. data.title: Network Customer Support Engineer
data.description: Location: Zurich, Paris or Munich Language: Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English. About Us Point One Navigation is building the future of precise location. Our mission is to deliver a unified location platform that enables autonomy, safety, and efficiency across industries from robotics to transportation. We are a high-performance, high-collaboration team that thrives on solving complex problems, moving fast, and delivering impact. Role Outcome The Network Customer Support Engineer owns the customer support experience tied to the reliability, visibility, and operational health of Point One’s correction network. This is a player-coach role. You will personally handle complex technical support cases while also leading the operational systems, monitoring, and processes that ensure the network performs reliably at scale. Success in this role means: Potential customer facing issues are identified and addressed before they impact customers. When incidents do occur, they are resolved quickly with clear communication and strong root-cause analysis. The organization has clear visibility into network health, operational trends, and customer friction. A scalable network operations and support function is built as the company and network footprint grow. Immediate Areas of Focus Own the customer experience of our Network Work with our Network Operations team to understand incidents that affect the customer experience Identify emerging issues and collaborate with engineering and manufacturing teams to understand and support the resolution of those issues. Understand available metrics and dashboards and contribute to the development of these tools to allow for the targeted resolution of customer questions. Deliver High-Quality Technical Support Liaison between Engineering, Network Operations and FAE and FDE team to support the customer. Personally manage high-impact or technically complex support cases. Partner closely with FAEs, Product, and Engineering to diagnose issues and close the loop with customers. Ensure customers receive clear, confident communication during investigations and incidents. Model best-in-class technical troubleshooting and customer engagement practices for the team. Build the Foundation for a Scalable Operations & Support Function Design and implement systems that enable both network operations and customer support to scale. Define a support ticket taxonomy that reflects customer use cases, technical complexity, and operational impact. Support Network Ops team on operational metrics such as: Network uptime and availability Incident response and resolution times Support response and resolution times Alert quality and monitoring coverage Document operational procedures, escalation paths, and ownership models. Develop automation and tooling to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency. Surface Operational and Customer Insights Identify patterns across support tickets, network events, and operational data. Translate operational signals into actionable insights for Product and Engineering. Ensure recurring issues and infrastructure gaps are clearly surfaced and prioritized. Create lightweight reporting that gives leadership visibility into network reliability, operational trends, and customer friction. Establish Visibility Into Customer Experience Define and implement the right metrics for understanding customer experience and operational impact. Establish mechanisms to collect structured customer feedback without creating noise. Use both operational data and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement. Coach and Develop the Operations & Support Function Act as a player-coach, leading through hands-on operational work while building the foundations of the team. Train and mentor support engineers on troubleshooting methodology, operational awareness, and customer communication. Establish clear expectations for technical depth, ownership, and responsiveness. Continuously raise the operational and support bar as the team grows. Qualifications Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English. Experience in a player-coach technical operations or support role where you owned both hands-on troubleshooting and operational systems. Strong technical background in GPS/GNSS, precise localization, geospatial infrastructure, or closely related domains (robotics, autonomy, embedded systems, positioning technologies). Experience operating or supporting distributed infrastructure or network-based systems. Demonstrated ability to build or significantly improve monitoring, alerting, and operational processes. Proven experience troubleshooting complex technical systems and working directly with customers. Experience conducting incident response and root cause analysis. Ability to define metrics, processes, and documentation without over-engineering. Comfort working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market teams in a fast-moving environment. Bias toward ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Our Cultural Foundation At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position. This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact . It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them. That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today , not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows. We think about our culture in two dimensions: How We Show Up Every Day These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate: Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting. High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us. Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles. No Ego, One Team — Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together. Self Accountability — Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust. Operating Principles These are the systems and norms that amplify speed and efficiency at the company level: Edge Innovation — We bias toward action over approval. Experiment, decide, and move — failure is just a step toward faster learning. No Hierarchies — We practice self-prioritization and go direct to the source. Flattening layers reduces drag and maximizes autonomy. Customer Experience First — We optimize for the end-to-end customer outcome, not functional or departmental efficiency. This focus cuts waste, aligns priorities, and ensures we spend effort where it matters most. If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. data.title: Sr Talent & People Partner
data.description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. The Role As our Senior Talent & People Partner, you will be the first hire in Rivia’s People team, working directly alongside the Head of People to build and scale the function from the ground up. You’ll own Talent Acquisition end to end while growing into the broader world of People: employee experience, development, performance, culture, organizational design, and operations. data.title: Sr Talent & People Partner
data.description: Über Rivia Rivia ist ein Technologieunternehmen, das eine Datenplattform entwickelt, die die Zukunft der klinischen Studienanalyse prägt. Rivia wurde aus der Überzeugung heraus gegründet, dass sich neue Medikamente mit einem Bruchteil des heutigen Kapitals erfolgreicher auf den Markt bringen lassen. Biotech-Unternehmen sind die wichtigste Quelle therapeutischer Innovationen. Ihre klinische Entwicklung wird jedoch immer wieder durch fragmentierte Daten und veraltete Werkzeuge ausgebremst. Rivia führt klinische Studiendaten in großem Maßstab zusammen. Das Herzstück ist eine wiederverwendbare intelligente Datenplattform mit Hunderten von Konfigurationen und studienspezifischen Logiken, die unabhängig von der Struktur der Quelldaten funktioniert. Diese vertikal integrierte Kombination aus Datenplattform, Workflows und KI-Agenten schafft einen entscheidenden Vorteil bei der Durchführung klinischer Studien. In den vergangenen zwei Jahren haben Biotech-Unternehmen aus Europa und den USA, die mit Rivia weltweit klinische Studien durchführen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielt: von einem früheren Verständnis des therapeutischen Potenzials bis hin zu deutlich effizienteren Studienabläufen. Im März 2026 nahm Rivia in einer Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde 15 Millionen US-Dollar auf, angeführt von Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia will zur Standardinfrastruktur für die moderne Arzneimittelentwicklung werden und die Durchführung klinischer Studien von Anfang bis Ende grundlegend verändern. Die Rolle Als Senior Talent & People Partner bist du die erste Verstärkung im People-Team von Rivia. Gemeinsam mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs baust du die Funktion von Grund auf auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess und wächst zugleich in weitere People-Themen hinein: Mitarbeitererfahrung, Entwicklung, Performance, Unternehmenskultur, Organisationsgestaltung und Personalprozesse. Die Position bietet erfahrenen Recruiter:innen die Möglichkeit, den nächsten Schritt in eine umfassendere People-Rolle zu machen. Ein fertiges HR-Handbuch, das du einfach übernimmst, gibt es nicht. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Prozesse, lösen neue Herausforderungen, probieren Ideen aus und schaffen die Grundlagen für das Wachstum von Rivia. Durch praktische Verantwortung, enge Zusammenarbeit und Einblicke in strategische Entscheidungen wie auch operative Herausforderungen lernst du direkt von der Leitung des People-Bereichs. Du bist die enge Sparringspartner:in der Leitung des People-Bereichs: Du denkst selbstständig, arbeitest vertrauensvoll zusammen und packst mit an. Du bringst Ideen ein, hinterfragst Annahmen, handelst schnell und setzt Vorhaben konsequent um. Gesucht ist jemand, der versteht, wie People-Arbeit zum Geschäftserfolg beiträgt, und Führungskräfte wirklich beraten möchte – statt lediglich Prozesse abzuarbeiten. Was dich begeistert Du liebst Recruiting, möchtest dich aber über Talent Acquisition hinaus weiterentwickeln und das gesamte People-Spektrum kennenlernen. Die erste Person im People-Team zu sein und alles von Grund auf mit aufzubauen, reizt dich mehr, als ein bestehendes Handbuch zu pflegen. Du arbeitest eng mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs zusammen, hinterfragst Ideen und lernst durch echte Verantwortung. Du findest außergewöhnliche Talente und baust vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften mit den einstellenden Führungskräften auf. Du löst komplexe Geschäfts- und People-Fragen schnell, neugierig und pragmatisch. Du möchtest die Mitarbeitererfahrung, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und Zusammenarbeit verbessern. Du ergreifst die Initiative, behältst verschiedene Prioritäten im Blick und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Deine Aufgaben Talent Acquisition Du verantwortest den gesamten Einstellungsprozess über alle Teams hinweg – von der Definition der Rolle über Talent Mapping, Active Sourcing, Interviews und die Betreuung der Kandidat:innen bis hin zu Angeboten und Vertragsabschlüssen. Du berätst einstellende Führungskräfte fundiert zu Recruiting-Strategie, Marktbedingungen, Qualität der Kandidat:innen und möglichen Kompromissen. Du baust proaktiv Talent-Pipelines auf und sorgst für eine wertschätzende, verlässliche Candidate Experience. Du verbesserst Recruiting-Prozesse, ATS-Workflows, Reporting und Recruiting-Analysen. Mitarbeitererfahrung und Entwicklung Gemeinsam mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs entwickelst du Onboarding, Mitarbeitererfahrung, Engagement, Unternehmenskultur und Entwicklungsinitiativen weiter. Du unterstützt die Einführung von Performance Reviews, Feedback-Praktiken, Karriereentwicklung und Angeboten für Führungskräfte. Du hörst den Anliegen von Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften zu, erkennst Reibungspunkte und setzt Erkenntnisse in konkrete Verbesserungen um. People Operations und Business-Partnerschaft Du hilfst dabei, skalierbare People-Prozesse, Richtlinien, Systeme und Abläufe entlang des gesamten Beschäftigungsverhältnisses von Grund auf aufzubauen. Du unterstützt Führungskräfte mit pragmatischer, geschäftsorientierter Beratung und durchdachten Personalentscheidungen. Mit wachsendem Verantwortungsbereich arbeitest du an Projekten zu Organisationsgestaltung, Vergütung, HR Operations und People Analytics mit. Du erkennst Probleme früh, schlägst Lösungen vor und kümmerst dich um deren Umsetzung, statt auf Anweisungen zu warten. Was du mitbringst Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Umfassende Erfahrung im Recruiting über den gesamten Einstellungsprozess hinweg sowie nachweisbare Erfolge bei der eigenständigen Besetzung anspruchsvoller Positionen. Den Wunsch, dich in eine umfassendere People-Rolle weiterzuentwickeln; Erfahrung als HR-Generalist:in ist nicht erforderlich. Du baust gern Neues auf, löst Probleme, handelst schnell, denkst kritisch und übernimmst Verantwortung bis zur Umsetzung. Geschäftssinn und die Sicherheit, einstellende Führungskräfte und andere Verantwortliche zu hinterfragen, zu überzeugen und zu beraten. Du fühlst dich wohl mit offenen Fragestellungen, hohen Erwartungen, mehreren parallelen Prioritäten und praktischer Arbeit. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, gutes Urteilsvermögen, Organisationstalent und Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Management. Neugier, Bescheidenheit und die Bereitschaft, neue People-Fachgebiete zu erschließen. Von Vorteil Kenntnisse des Schweizer Arbeitsrechts. Einblicke in Mitarbeiterentwicklung, Performance Management oder Mitarbeiterengagement. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up sowie Vertrautheit mit ATS-, HRIS- oder People-Analytics-Systemen. Bewerbungsprozess Unser Bewerbungsprozess dauert in der Regel zwei bis vier Wochen und umfasst vier Schritte: Kennenlernen: 30-minütiges erstes Gespräch mit dem People-Team. Vertiefendes Gespräch: Austausch mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs über Recruiting, Business-Partnerschaft und deine Entwicklungsziele. Praxisaufgabe: Gemeinsame Bearbeitung einer realistischen Recruiting- und People-Herausforderung. Kennenlernen des Teams: Gespräche vor Ort in Zürich, um herauszufinden, ob wir gut zueinander passen. Unsere Werte Bei Rivia setzen wir auf Spitzenleistung, kontinuierliches Lernen und den Erfolg unserer Kund:innen und unseres Teams. Mit vollem Einsatz gewinnen: Herausforderungen mit Entschlossenheit, Ausdauer und Tatkraft angehen. Veränderung annehmen: Wandel als Chance zur Verbesserung sehen. Warum eigentlich nicht?: Annahmen hinterfragen und neugierig bleiben. Lücken erkennen: Probleme frühzeitig identifizieren und lösen. Gemeinsam Verantwortung übernehmen: Zusammen für Ergebnisse einstehen und einander unterstützen. Lösungen mit Mehrwert schaffen: Sinnvolle Ergebnisse erzielen, die wirklich etwas bewirken. data.title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
data.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations. What you’ll do Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability. Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers. Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them. Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers. Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up. Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations. What you'll bring Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user. Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC). NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0. JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors. A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching. Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us. A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role. Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region. Nice to have: Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite). Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP). Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD. Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor. Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope. Integration Engineer Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards. Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces. Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team. Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions. Senior Integration Engineer Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards. Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments. Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow. Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases. Why BLP Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live. Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards. Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares. Team: regular team events. Practical information Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe. If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich. Employment: full-time, permanent. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . data.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
data.description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation and control stack of the fusion energy reactors of the future. Our technology enables effective and reliable operation, monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices — which will one day provide clean, practically limitless power to the grid. We have spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and have just completed our pre-seed fundraise. We are looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to join our founding team in Lausanne and help build our core technology. This job is for you if you are a passionate engineer with deep knowledge cutting across real-time / embedded systems, software and hardware, and excited about building the systems to monitor and control real-world fusion plasmas. Tasks Implement real-time control, analysis, data acquisition systems in the kHz to MHz range, as individual contributor and in a team. Integrate solutions across a variety of company products and services as well as on our in-house test beds. Provide technical leadership within a growing real-time control and software engineering team that you will help to build. Translate customer needs into requirements and specifications. Requirements Experience taking hard-real-time acquisition and control loops from incomplete requirements through to commissioning on hardware, in domains such as automotive, robotics, embedded, electrical and/or scientific instrumentation. ‘Full stack’: familiarity with all aspects of real-time technologies, from physical/DAQ, real-time software frameworks and middleware, real-time OS and integration. Fluency in a mix of high-level and low-level languages such as C, C++, Rust, MATLAB/Simulink, Python. Obsession with code quality, testing and reliability. Experience with distributed real-time systems, real-time networking and field buses and/or SCADA is an advantage. Experience with embedded/μC/FPGA technologies and/or safety critical systems is an advantage. data.title: Head of Finance & Administration
data.description: The role H55 is looking for a versatile and hands on Head of Finance & Administration to lead its corporate functions and ensure the effective running of its Swiss site. This broad leadership role combines a solid finance background with strong corporate governance and practical operational management. Working closely with the CEO and leadership team, you will connect people, priorities and resources, providing the structure and support needed to deliver the company’s business objectives. You will develop a thorough understanding of H55’s corporate framework, including its shareholder arrangements, financing agreements and key contractual commitments, and translate these obligations into clear responsibilities, practical policies and timely action. You will oversee finance, HR, IT, facilities and general administration, supported by internal specialists and external partners. As a central point of coordination for Swiss site matters, you will help teams resolve operational issues, improve ways of working and ensure corporate services meet the needs of the business. Key responsibilities Corporate governance and administration Coordinate Board and shareholder matters with the CEO and legal counsel, including meeting preparation, resolutions, corporate records and follow through on decisions. Maintain a clear overview of the company’s corporate structure, shareholder arrangements, financing agreements and material contractual commitments. Track related obligations and deadlines, ensuring clear ownership and timely action across relevant functions. Ensure governance requirements, delegated authorities and approval processes are understood and applied. Manage relationships with external legal advisers, insurers and corporate service providers. Policies, compliance and internal controls Coordinate the development, implementation and review of company policies in line with business needs, investor commitments and applicable requirements. Work with functional owners on anti corruption, cybersecurity and incident response, related party transactions, internal financial controls, global trade controls, personal data protection, and health and safety. Translate policies into practical procedures, with clear responsibilities and guidance for employees and managers. Coordinate communication and training, maintaining appropriate records. Monitor implementation, address gaps with relevant owners and bring matters requiring attention to the leadership team. Swiss site and corporate services Coordinate Swiss site administration and corporate support activities, working closely with production, engineering and other teams. Oversee facilities, workplace services and external providers, ensuring a safe and effective working environment. Help resolve site issues and coordinate improvements that support daily operations. Oversee IT services and infrastructure through internal resources and external partners. Drive improvements in digital tools, systems and administrative processes. Coordinate site procedures and business continuity arrangements with relevant specialists. HR oversight and organisational support Oversee the HR function, supporting the HR team in delivering effective people processes and reliable daily operations. Work with the CEO and managers on workforce planning, organisational changes and recruitment priorities. Ensure employment administration, payroll coordination and HR policies are managed consistently and appropriately. Support clear internal communication and effective collaboration across teams. Financial management and business support Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash flow planning and financial reporting, supported by internal finance resources and external partners. Ensure reliable accounting, statutory reporting, tax and audit processes. Provide clear financial visibility to support business decisions and resource allocation. Maintain appropriate financial controls, spending discipline and approval processes. Monitor costs and commitments with budget owners and programme teams. Support investor reporting, financing activities and due diligence when required. Leadership and continuous improvement Lead and support a small multidisciplinary team, coordinating external expertise where needed. Set priorities, allocate resources and ensure actions are completed. Build trusted working relationships with managers and colleagues across the organisation. Simplify processes and adapt corporate services as the business evolves. Your profile Experience in a broad finance and administration, corporate services or business operations leadership role. A solid finance background, with experience taking responsibility beyond the finance function. Strong understanding of corporate governance and confidence working with corporate documents, contractual commitments and legal advisers. Experience implementing policies and translating compliance requirements into practical ways of working. Experience coordinating site operations or corporate support functions, ideally in a technology or industrial environment. Familiarity with the Swiss business environment and relevant administrative and statutory requirements. Ability to lead across different functions, drawing on the expertise of colleagues and external partners. Sound judgement, discretion and the ability to build trust with people across the organisation. A practical, collaborative approach, with strong organisational skills and a willingness to get involved in day to day matters. Fluent English and French. A relevant qualification in finance, business administration or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. You do not need to be a specialist in every function. You should be comfortable asking the right questions, bringing together the right expertise and taking responsibility for progress. Why join H55? At H55, you will work closely with the people developing electric aviation technology and help create the conditions for them to succeed. Your decisions will shape how we work, support our teams and move the business forward. You will have room to bring ideas, improve how things are done and see the results of your work. If you enjoy connecting people, making sense of complex issues and turning decisions into action, this role offers the opportunity to do all three. We would like to hear from you We are building a team with a range of backgrounds and perspectives, and we value people who bring different ways of thinking and working. If this role interests you but you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. H55 is committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from all qualified individuals regardless of nationality, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age. data.title: Site Reliability Engineer
data.description: About Us: DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry. Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage. Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it. About the role: As a Site Reliability Engineer at DeepJudge, you own the reliability of the systems that leading law firms depend on every day. We run our AI search platform in dedicated production environments, each a large-scale search and retrieval system operating at very high data volumes, alongside our ingestion pipelines and data stores, on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds. Keeping those environments fast, available, and trustworthy is a genuine engineering challenge, and it's your mission. This is a technical, infrastructure-focused role: you'll spend your time in systems, code, and telemetry. You'll harden the platform so that classes of failure can't recur, build observability and SLOs to let us see problems before they surface, plan capacity ahead of relentless data growth, and automate away the toil of safely operating many production environments. You'll work across our deployment and infrastructure-as-code and partner closely with product engineering to feed reliability learnings back into the platform. If you like operating serious distributed systems at scale and turning firefighting into engineered reliability, this role is for you. Your responsibilities will include: Owning the availability, latency and performance of our production environments: large-scale search and retrieval services, ingestion and data stores on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds Owning the cloud infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds, networking, identity and access, compute and storage, and managing cloud capacity, quotas and cost as the fleet grows Improving deployment and infrastructure through code: GitOps-based configuration and deployment and infrastructure-as-code across our public and private clouds, with safe, previewed, recoverable production changes Defining and instrumenting SLOs and error budgets and building the dashboards, metrics and alerting that make production observable and actionable Reducing operational toil through automation and internal tooling written in Python and / or Go Provisioning and standardizing new production environments to a defined reliability bar You're a great fit if you: Have 3+ years in SRE, production / platform engineering, or infrastructure-heavy software engineering, operating real production systems under reliability expectations Are strong at container-orchestration operations in production and comfortable on at least one major public cloud Have solid cloud infrastructure experience on a major public cloud and a working grasp of cloud capacity, quotas, and cost Practice observability hands-on with metrics, logs and traces, and use it to root-cause live incidents Work fluently with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps Can code in Python and / or Go for automation, tooling, and reading and patching service code. Bring sound production judgment and document your work clearly for other engineers Bonus: experience operating a large-scale search or distributed data system, database operations, dedicated / enterprise-deployed software, or AI / enterprise-search infrastructure in regulated domains What you can look forward to: Owning the reliability of systems that the world's leading law firms rely on: real scale, real impact Deep, hands-on work with modern infrastructure: distributed search at very large scale, container orchestration across multiple clouds, and a mature infrastructure-as-code and GitOps stack A rigorous, high-urgency engineering culture founded by ex-Google search engineers and ETH Zurich AI PhDs The chance to build the reliability discipline, SLOs, incident practice, automation, from a strong foundation, not inherit a rigid one A collaborative team in Zurich shaping how AI transforms professional knowledge work At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. data.title: R&D Mechanical Engineer
data.description: As a R&D Mechanical Engineer within our Mechanical team, you will lead development of mechanical systems and subsystems of our next-generation surgical robot from the early concept to the to a verified product. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES : R&D & Mechatronic Subsystem Design • Lead the end-to-end design and development of high-precision mechatronic subsystems for surgical robotics, translating clinical and industrial design inputs into simple and robust mechanical solutions. • Execute detailed design work utilizing 3D CAD (Solidworks), finite element analysis (FEA), and worst-case tolerance stack-up analyses. And applying DFM/DFA principles to optimize cost, yield, and assembly efficiency. • Collaborate within cross-functional R&D teams (Electrical, Software, Systems, and Clinical) to rapidly prototype, validate, and iterate robotic platforms and subsystems. Verification, Testing & Tooling • Architect, build and document custom mechatronic test benches and automated test fixtures for design verification, fatigue testing, and end-of-line production testing. • Author and execute verification protocols and reports to prove subsystem performance against medical device requirements. Design Transfer & Supply Chain • Support Design Transfer to Contract Manufacturers, by transferring technical knowledge to industrialization teams, reviewing Work Instructions and pFMEAs, and supporting process-specific tool development. • Support mechanical supplier selection and qualification, support root-cause analyses for supplier-related quality issues (NC/CAPA). Medical Device Compliance & Lifecycle • Maintain full compliance with medical device standards (e.g., ISO 13485, IEC 60601-1, ISO 14971) and author compliant Design History File (DHF) documentation. • Plan and execute Engineering Change Requests, ensuring robust risk management and traceability. • Chair formal technical design reviews and present architectural decisions to cross-departmental stakeholders and leadership. Requirements Work Experience and Education requirements : • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline. • Relevant Experience: data.title: Senior Outsourced Sales Manager: Vinted Go Acquisition
data.description: Brief info about Vinted Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. Information about the position Vinted Go grows by signing new pick-up/drop-off locations, and a large share of that growth is delivered by external sales agencies. You will own that network: the agencies running our field sales, virtual calling and digital outreach across Europe and the US. Today these relationships are managed in a fragmented way. Your job is to turn them into one well-governed, high-performing extension of the acquisition team, with clear targets, a consistent operating rhythm and a single point of accountability. This is a high-ownership role. You will act as an agency manager, performance analyst and budget owner, and above all as the guardian of the Vinted Go sales approach in every conversation an agency has on our behalf. You will build on the structure that already exists. In this position, you’ll Agency & Channel Management Own the full relationship with every outsourced sales partner across countries: onboarding, day-to-day management, escalations and offboarding Be the single point of accountability for agency sales results, replacing today's fragmented oversight Negotiate and manage contracts, SLAs and commercial terms, including pay-for-performance structures Evaluate, select and onboard new sales agencies as we enter new markets Build one operating framework (reporting cadence, WBRs, MBRs, escalation paths) that works the same way across agencies, channels and countries Performance Management Define and track sales KPIs and SLAs per agency, channel and market: conversion, signed locations per rep, productivity, lead quality and adherence to the Vinted Go pitch Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into performance across the whole network Spot underperforming agencies or markets early and drive corrective action plans Translate acquisition targets set by leadership into agency-level performance expectations Run calibration and quality assurance (call reviews, field ride-alongs) so every agency sells consistently Budget Management Own the outsourced sales budget across all agencies and countries: forecasting, spend tracking and variance reporting Analyze cost per outcome (CAC, cost per signed location, cost per hour) across agencies, channels and markets to drive efficiency Find and execute cost optimizations without compromising quality Report on budget and performance regularly to finance and leadership Scale & Process Design the processes and governance needed to run a multi-agency, multi-country, multi-language sales network sustainably Build and maintain playbooks for opening new markets and onboarding new agencies Work with the acquisition team to align on targets, budgets and reporting standards About you Senior experience managing external sales agencies or outsourced sales teams (field sales, telesales, digital lead generation), ideally across several countries and vendors at once A background in sales, acquisition or growth in a high-velocity environment, so you know what good looks like on the ground A strong record of agency performance management: setting KPIs and SLAs, running WBRs and MBRs, and driving accountability Budget ownership: forecasting, tracking and optimizing spend across multiple vendors or cost centers Comfort building structure and process from a relatively unstructured starting point Strong analytical skills, working easily in dashboards, reporting tools and a CRM to track performance and cost Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills: you hold agencies accountable while keeping the partnership productive Comfort working across time zones and cultures Fluent English; French and/or Spanish is an advantage Why This Role Matters Outsourced sales is one of the main ways Vinted Go signs new locations at scale, and it is growing in every market we enter. This role brings order, accountability and cost discipline to that network, and lays the foundation for further international and product growth. Work perks The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme 25 days of paid annual leave Newest MacBook models Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family Frequent team-building events Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture Lunch benefit per working day Company bike leasing scheme Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport A dog-friendly office Working at Vinted Workation policy Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time. Individual learning budget Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development. Equal opportunity We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. Eliminate alert fatigue across Vinted, collaborating with engineering teams to group noisy alerts, establish alert standards, and make every page actionable. Advance practical AI in production, designing the event pipelines that allow our AI incident agent to accurately suggest root causes during live outages in minutes. Define standards for SLOs and alerts across Vinted, and simplify the tools teams use to create them. Define and track the product and process metrics that show whether our work makes a difference. Keep alert routing and our other critical systems reliable and simple to operate, so the team can move faster. Act as a technical mentor and multiplier for a growing team of five engineers, elevating their engineering discipline through thoughtful system design reviews and collaborative RFCs. Our platform is built in Go, but we warmly welcome strong backgrounds in Java, Rust, Python, C++, or similar technologies. Strong product mindset for developer tooling. You treat other engineers as your customers, listen to user pain points, and measure success by adoption and developer happiness. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. The Role Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform. Your impact This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data. What You Will Do Product Requirements & Roadmap Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team. Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance. Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems. Partner Lab Onboarding Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter. Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster. Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences. Closed-Loop Campaigns Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples. Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners. Must Have Skills and Qualifications: PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research. Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia. Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab. Firsthand understanding of how experimental data is produced and where it fails: which metadata and provenance matter, instrument quirks, data quality issues, and what makes a dataset usable for machine learning. Depth in at least one materials domain (e.g. semiconductors and thin films including photovoltaics, catalysis and electrochemistry, energy materials including batteries, polymers and formulations, or separations and surfaces) and the curiosity to work across others. Working knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis; comfortable working with APIs and data schemas. Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partner labs as well as multidisciplinary science, ML, product and engineering teams. Bonus Points (But Not Critical): Direct experience with closed-loop optimisation in an automated setting, such as Bayesian optimisation, active learning or design of experiments. Experience with research data management, LIMS/ELN systems, FAIR data or metadata schemas, and familiarity with lab data standards (e.g. SiLA 2, AnIML, Allotrope). Instrument integration experience, including vendor software, data formats, and scheduling or orchestration. Product or project management experience, such as roadmaps, user research, external research collaborations or vendor relationships. We are equally open to strong experimental scientists making their first move into product. Experience working in industry at a materials, chemicals, energy or deep-tech company, or closely with industry at a research institution or national lab. Experience coordinating work across multiple labs, sites or countries. Additional Considerations This role could be based in any of our locations with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to partner labs and other locations for collaboration and project work. What We Offer A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world. CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace . We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law. We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team. Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate. data.title: Senior Data Engineering Consultant
data.description: Als Senior Data Engineering Consultant bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien. Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging. Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit. Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je werkt aan complexe projecten voor grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een klein, informeel en hecht team van vakgenoten dat elkaar uitdaagt en inspireert. Bij BigData Republic ben je de expert in de kamer én leer je elke dag van je collega’s. En vooral: je kunt hier jezelf zijn. In de praktijk besteed je ongeveer 90% van je tijd aan klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor eigen initiatieven: een pet project, innovatie of een idee dat je samen met collega’s wilt uitwerken. Je past goed bij deze rol als je ervaring hebt met (een deel van) onderstaande tooling en concepten: Je hebt een sterke basis in; Python Cloud (AWS, GCP of Azure) Data pipelines bouwen en ouderhouden (ELT/ ETL) Data warehousing (Databricks, Snowflake of BigQuery) Orchestratie (Airflow, Dagster) Terraform, CI/ CD Pluspunten, maar geen vereiste: Streaming (Kafka, Spark, Flink) DevOps (Kubernetes) Data Governance en management (bijvoorbeeld dbt) Ervaring met AI en of ML infrastructuur (feature stores, vector databases, ML pipelines) Je hoeft niet alles te beheersen. Nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en technische diepgang vinden we belangrijker dan een perfecte checklist. Benefits Salaris tussen €5.500 en €6.700 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van kennis, ervaring en senioriteit Vakantiegeld, 8% Lease- en Mobiliteitsbudget van €925 per maand Bonus- en pensioenregeling 25 Vakantiedagen Hybride werken: de juiste balans tussen thuis, kantoor en klant Vrije keuze in laptop en telefoon Ruimte voor kennisdeling, certificeringen en conferentiebezoek (haal die badge!) Vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportactiviteiten en sociale events (vrijblijvend) Uitdagende én leuke projecten bij aansprekende klanten Een informele cultuur met ruimte voor initiatief en innovatie CAO & arbeidsvoorwaarden Conflux is aangesloten bij de Vereniging van Detacheerders Nederland (VvDN); op deze functie is de CAO voor Detacheerders Nederland (VvDN) van toepassing. Over BigData Republic BigData Republic is een high-end consultancybureau gespecialiseerd in data science, data engineering en machine learning. We zijn AI-native en combineren dit met diepgaande engineering kennis. Op deze manier bieden wij onze klanten technische begeleiding tot duurzame en innovatieve oplossingen. Als niche-consultancyteam onderscheiden we ons van de grote spelers: we leveren kwaliteit boven kwantiteit en willen een thought leader in ons vakgebied zijn. Voor onze klanten richten we ons op het creëren van businesswaarde met innovatieve datasolutions die een duurzame impact hebben. Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele pijlers van onze organisatie: elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogposts, organiseren meetups en bezoeken conferenties. data.title: Projectleider Cybersecurity Congres | RDI
data.description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur (RDI ) op zoek naar een ervaren Projectleider . De RDI zet zich in voor een veilig verbonden Nederland en werkt aan actuele thema’s zoals cyberveiligheid, digitale weerbaarheid, AI, 5G en digitale infrastructuur. De opdracht vindt plaats binnen de directie Digitale Weerbaarheid en richt zich op de organisatie van de NISDUC 2027 (NIS Directive User Community), een internationaal congres op het gebied van digitale weerbaarheid, cybersecurity en toezicht. Tijdens dit congres komen toezichthouders, overheden en professionals uit Nederland, België en Luxemburg samen om kennis en ervaringen uit te wisselen rondom onder meer NIS2 en cybersecurity. Als Projectleider ben je verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke en organisatorische aansturing van het congres en zorg je voor een succesvolle realisatie van het programma en de samenwerking met alle betrokken partijen. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Je voert de projectleiding over het volledige programma van NISDUC 2027. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de organisatie van het internationale cybersecuritycongres. Je ontwikkelt, beheert en vult de verschillende programmalijnen en tracks. Je stemt af met betrokken overheidsorganisaties, toezichthouders en partners. Je organiseert internationale kennisuitwisseling en samenwerking binnen het congresprogramma. Je stuurt het betrokken evenementenbureau aan. Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit, voortgang en resultaten van het congres. Je draagt zorg voor een professioneel en inhoudelijk sterk programma rondom digitale weerbaarheid en cybersecurity Wat vragen wij? Eisen: Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-opleiding. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als projectleider. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen het cybersecuritydomein. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met het aansturen van de organisatie van inhoudelijke congressen. Je hebt ervaring met complexe opdrachten en omvangrijke trajecten met een hoog afbreukrisico. Je bent in het bezit van een projectmanagementcertificering. Aanvullende wensen: Je hebt ervaring als projectleider binnen de Rijksoverheid. Je hebt ervaring met het organiseren van cybersecurity-events. Je hebt ervaring met samenwerkingspartners binnen het cybersecuritydomein, zoals het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum (NCSC). Competenties Je bent bestuurlijk sensitief. Je bent communicatief sterk. Je bent creatief in het ontwikkelen van programma’s en oplossingen. Je beschikt over organisatiesensitiviteit. Je weet verschillende belangen effectief samen te brengen. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van een publieke organisatie en beweegt je gemakkelijk binnen een complexe stakeholderomgeving. Informatie Start: 2 november 2026 Aantal uur: 16 tot 20 uur per week Lengte opdracht: 8 maanden Locatie: Amersfoort Vorm: ZZP Schaalniveau: 14 Geïnteresseerd? Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor maandag 26 oktober 9.00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht. data.title: Senior Cosmetic Chemist
data.description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Cosmetic Chemist for our KEUNE Beauty Solutions team. You combine excellent formulation skills with the confidence to tackle development projects independently. You will remain closely involved in hands-on laboratory work while taking responsibility for assigned projects, guiding fellow medior and junior chemists, and working directly with clients and cross-functional teams to bring high-performing products to market. At KEUNE, we develop and manufacture not only our own professional haircare products but also products for KEUNE Beauty Solutions (KBS), our private label division. Through KBS, we partner with beauty brands worldwide, offering end-to-end solutions from formulation development and manufacturing to the delivery of finished products. MISSION Lead assigned new product development projects from brief to commercialization, taking ownership of technical execution, deliverables, timelines, and follow-up in line with the NPD process. Develop and optimize haircare, hairstyling, and hair color formulations through hands-on laboratory work, ensuring product performance, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance. Act as technical reference for assigned projects: review client briefs, clarify requirements, identify risks, and translate expectations into a clear development plan. Participate in and lead technical discussions with clients, working alongside Project Management and Commercial teams to align expectations, feasibility, and next steps. Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level chemists working on shared projects, while maintaining ownership for project outcomes. Plan, organize, execute, document, and follow up on submissions, stability, safety, and performance testing, ensuring decisions and results are properly tracked. Proactively identify potential delays or technical challenges, communicate them early, and drive practical solutions with the relevant stakeholders. Support scale-up, first production runs, and troubleshooting in collaboration with Production and Quality Control. Stay informed about market trends, emerging ingredients, and technologies, and turn insights into relevant innovation concepts and proposals for clients.
