data.title: Senior Accountmanager Zorg & ICT
data.description: Je opent nieuwe deuren bij zorgorganisaties en bouwt vanuit vertrouwen aan nieuwe samenwerkingen. Wil jij bijdragen aan dienstverlening in de zorg die er echt toe doet? Krijg jij energie van het leggen van nieuwe contacten en het omzetten van een eerste gesprek in een duurzame samenwerking? En geloof jij oprecht dat goede digitale zorg het verschil maakt voor patiënt en zorgprofessional? Dan willen we jou graag leren kennen. Bij Beter Healthcare draait accountmanagement niet in de eerste plaats om de cijfers. Het draait om mensen, vertrouwen en trots zijn op wat je doet, en om de sterke drive om de zorg én Beter Healthcare stap voor stap vooruit te helpen. Elke dag weer. Wat je gaat doen Als (Senior) Accountmanager ben jij voor nieuwe zorgorganisaties vaak de eerste kennismaking met Beter Healthcare . Je richt je op ziekenhuizen, GGZ- en VVT-organisaties en samenwerkingsverbanden waar we nog niet of nauwelijks werken. Je verkoopt geen product, maar dienstverlening : advies, projectmanagement, interim-inzet en implementatie, samen met de consultants die de inhoud brengen. Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. Tegelijk verkoop je niets wat niet past: je begint bij echte interesse in de klant en zijn uitdagingen. En je bent een echte teamspeler. Eerst het team, daarna jijzelf. Geen groot ego, geen solist. Je groeit hard mee met ons bedrijf, helemaal in lijn met onze missie: hoe meer we groeien, hoe groter onze positieve impact op de zorg. Jouw werkzaamheden omvatten onder andere: · Je brengt de markt in kaart, kiest doelorganisaties en bouwt een gerichte pipeline op; · Je legt contact met CIO's, CMIO's, managers informatievoorziening, inkopers en bestuurders, via je eigen netwerk en actieve acquisitie; · Je verkent in gesprekken wat er echt speelt en vertaalt dat samen met consultants naar een passend voorstel; · Je stelt offertes op en onderhandelt over inzet, tarieven en voorwaarden; · Je volgt aanbestedingen en raamovereenkomsten en coördineert inschrijvingen; · Je vertegenwoordigt Beter Healthcare op netwerkevenementen, congressen en vakbijeenkomsten, op een manier die past bij onze waarden: betrokken, betrouwbaar en bekwaam; · Je rapporteert over pipeline, forecast en kansen aan het managementteam en hebt dat gewoon goed op orde. Wie jij bent Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder : iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin? · Je haalt energie uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en hebt het doorzettingsvermogen dat daarbij hoort; · Je hebt een intrinsieke drive om bij te dragen aan betere zorg door digitalisering; · Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig: de wereld van zorg en ICT blijft je boeien en je houdt je kennis actief bij; · Je bent een echte teamspeler en zet het gezamenlijke resultaat boven je eigen ego; · Je hebt minimaal acht jaar ervaring in de verkoop van dienstverlening , zoals consultancy, interim of detachering, in de zorg-ICT; · Je hebt een trackrecord in het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en kent de inkoop- en aanbestedingsprocessen in de zorg; · Je beschikt over een actief netwerk bij zorgorganisaties, bij voorkeur op het niveau van CIO, CMIO, IM-management of bestuur; · Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau; · Je communiceert helder en overtuigend in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op: · Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring; · Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon; · Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren; · Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op onze commerciële koers; · Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk; · Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren; · Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties; · Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt; · Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen; · Heel veel plezier in een prachtig team. Over Beter Healthcare Beter Healthcare is een consultancybureau op het snijvlak van zorg en ICT. We ondersteunen zorgorganisaties bij de digitalisering van hun processen en dragen zo bij aan een toekomstbestendige zorg. We zijn al met zo'n 100 IT healthcare specialisten en we groeien hard: niet als doel op zich, maar omdat onze klanten ons nodig hebben en onze aanpak werkt. Sinds 2012 helpen we zorgorganisaties met advies, projectmanagement en beheer. Onze kracht is dat we niet alleen adviseren, maar ook samen met klanten oplossingen succesvol implementeren. Onze consultants kennen de zorg van binnenuit, en dat maakt echt het verschil. Beter Healthcare is onderdeel van IG&H, een toonaangevend adviesbureau dat verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de resultaten van zijn werk. Met de eigen ‘Make Strategy Work’-methodologie richt IG&H zich op digitale transformaties. Binnen IG&H Health werken we samen met teams die gespecialiseerd zijn in onder meer strategy consulting, data en AI, security en managed cloudservices. Voel jij een “ja”? Zie jij jezelf hierin terug en wil je met jouw energie en talent bijdragen aan de groei van Beter Healthcare én aan betere zorg in Nederland? Vul dan het sollicitatieformulier in. We ontmoeten je graag! data.title: Senior Partner Solutions Engineer - EMEA
data.description: The Sr. Partner Solutions Engineer is a highly experienced technical lead responsible for driving the growth and technical enablement of our key partners (Telcos, Global Systems Integrators, Resellers and BPOs) across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg and Germany. This senior individual contributor role reports directly to the Vice President, Partner Solution Engineering. You will act as the primary technical point of contact, supporting partners in establishing and scaling their Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and Customer Experience Automation (CXA) practices built around the Talkdesk platform. This role involves deep technical engagement, partner enablement, co-selling support, and providing technical thought leadership to ensure mutual partner and customer success across the assigned territories. Key Responsibilities Partner Enablement & Practice Development Lead Technical Enablement: Design and execute comprehensive enablement plans to educate partner Solutions Architects and Sales Engineers on the Talkdesk value proposition, product architecture, competitive differentiators, and roadmap. Partner Center of Excellence: Support the development of Partner Competency Centers by coaching on effective technical discovery, platform demonstrations, and proof-of-concept (POC) execution. Domain Expertise: Develop and maintain deep domain expertise in the regional Partner landscape, understanding their current go-to-market (GTM) strategy, areas of focus, and identifying new opportunities for expansion. Co-Selling Support & Technical Leadership Agentic AI Focus: Provide technical expertise on Agentic AI solutions within the contact center, including prompt engineering, RAG implementations, tools integration, and guardrail best practices. Customer Engagement: Provide technical oversight, guidance, and direct assistance to Partner sales teams in understanding complex customer business and technical requirements, use cases, and solution design. Ecosystem Integration: Develop a deep understanding of the enterprise ecosystem, including integration requirements with CRM (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), WFM, Knowledge Management, and UCaaS vendors. Strategic Contribution & Communication Voice of the Partner: Act as the critical communication channel to Talkdesk Product Management and Engineering teams, relaying Partner and customer needs, market trends, and product enhancement requests. Market Representation: Represent Talkdesk as a technical expert at regional Partner summits, technical events, webinars, and conferences. Travel: Travel approximately 70% of the time across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg, working primarily from partner offices. Essential Skills & Experience Regional Experience: 10+ years of experience as a Partner Solutions Engineer or Pre-Sales Engineer in the CCaaS/CXA sector. Language Requirements: Business-level fluency in Dutch and professional fluency in English are required. German or French as a further language is highly desirable. Communication: Excellent communication, presentation, and whiteboard session skills with an ability to lead advanced technical discussions and deliver compelling platform demonstrations for enterprise customers & Partners. Partner Background: Solid experience working with Service Providers, Regional Systems Integrators, National Partners, and VARs , with a proven understanding of a partner-centric GTM approach within the Benelux market. Technical Leadership: Proven ability to lead and drive complex technical engagements and serve as a subject matter expert without direct people management responsibilities. Telephony & Protocol Knowledge: Experience with at least one Unified Communication protocol (e.g., SIP, WebRTC, RTP) and familiarity with Call/Message processing Proxies and Session Border Controllers. Applied AI Expertise: Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with modern Agentic AI technologies, including the practical application of LLMs for Contact Center and Customer Experience Automation use cases. Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS, or an equivalent combination of education and years of relevant experience. Method of Application : Apply online. Application Window : The application window is expected to close at least 5 days from the posting date. The application was posted on 10/18/2026. Benefits and perks listed above may vary based on the nature of your employment with Talkdesk. All questions or concerns about this posting should be directed to the Talent team at Talkdesk is pioneering a new era of Customer Experience Automation (CXA), redefining how the world’s most admired brands interact with their customers through AI. Our global team of courageous innovators is customer-obsessed, building AI-first solutions that put empathy, trust, and transparency at the center of every interaction. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive our success and every voice belongs. Combining the stability of a global leader with the agility of a disruptor, Talkdeskers are empowered with the autonomy to drive meaningful impact, while giving back to the communities and environment around us. Talkdesk has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and in the G2 Overall Grid® Reports for AI Agents and Contact Center. With seven consecutive years on the Forbes Cloud 100 and multiple AI Breakthrough awards, there has never been a more exciting time to join us as we shape the future of customer experience automation! Work Environment and Physical Requirements: Primarily office-environment work, extended periods of sitting or standing, computer-based work. Limited lifting, and equipment usage limited to computer-related equipment (keyboards, mouse, etc.) The Talkdesk story hinges on empathy and acceptance. It is the shared goal among all Talkdeskers to empower a new kind of customer hero through our innovative software solution, and we firmly believe that the best path to success for our mission is inclusivity, diversity, and genuine acceptance. data.title: Senior Google Ads Specialist | International E-commerce | Remote ASAP
data.description: ennovationHUB is a rapidly growing international e-commerce group operating in the home & living category, with a strong focus on furniture. From our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers across the UK, North America, EU, and APAC. As we work toward €160m+ annual revenue by 2027, we are looking for a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us ASAP and take ownership of Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands, with direct accountability for growth, efficiency, and profitability. This is not a typical agency PPC role focused on managing a handful of campaigns. You will join a multi-brand international e-commerce group with significant advertising budgets, multiple markets, and a clear view of how your work influences revenue and profitability. Google Ads is central to our growth strategy. Working across multiple countries and brands brings both complexity and opportunity. We are looking for people who enjoy working with large datasets, identifying performance opportunities, and consistently improving results through testing, analysis, and execution. You will collaborate closely with our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists to ensure campaigns perform well today and continue to scale efficiently as the business grows. Take ownership of Google Ads performance for one e-commerce brand across multiple international markets Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types Monitor and improve key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability Be directly accountable for growth, efficiency, and performance within your portfolio Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, markets, and audience segments Analyse campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations Conduct account audits and implement ongoing optimisation initiatives Work closely with developers and analytics teams to ensure accurate tracking and measurement Collaborate with creative and content teams to improve ad performance and landing page effectiveness Support budget planning, forecasting, and performance reporting Stay current with platform developments, AI-driven advertising features, and industry best practices Contribute to testing strategies and experimentation frameworks that improve long-term account performance You will be joining a business where Google Ads already delivers results. Your role is to build on that success by identifying opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling what works. We operate in a competitive e-commerce environment where even small improvements can have a significant impact. You will work alongside experienced colleagues who move quickly and care about results. We value people who think independently, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of outcomes. This is not a support or reporting role. You will be trusted to make decisions, own results, and directly influence the growth of the business. This role is strictly for candidates with in-house e-commerce experience. Applicants whose primary Google Ads experience comes from agencies, consultancies, or freelance work will not be considered. We are looking for people who have owned performance outcomes within an e-commerce business, where success is measured by revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and long-term growth rather than client management and campaign delivery. You should have experience working directly within a commercial business and feel comfortable taking responsibility for results, beyond simply providing recommendations. Our Ideal Candidate Will Have: 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads for an e-commerce business, with direct responsibility for performance and profitability Strong experience with Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns Proven experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team rather than as an agency, consultant, or freelancer Comfortable analysing large datasets and identifying actionable insights Strong understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center Highly analytical with strong attention to detail Fluent in English, both written and spoken Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities Curious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvement Able to take ownership and make decisions independently We are actively pushing AI and automation across the business, so you need to be comfortable working in that direction and not resistant to change Senior, but practical Data-driven without becoming overly theoretical Comfortable taking ownership and making decisions Naturally curious and always looking for performance improvements Focused on outcomes rather than activity Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution Motivated by building and scaling rather than simply maintaining campaigns Available to start immediately / ASAP We are investing in strengthening our presence there and expect it to become an increasingly important location for our team over time. Our wider team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. The role involves travel approximately every 4-8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations for planning sessions, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions. While most work takes place remotely, we value spending time together in person, particularly as the company continues to scale. This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to make a meaningful contribution to scaling an international e-commerce business over the coming years. In Our Culture at ennovationHUB, We Value: Accountability over excuses Execution over talk Clarity over politics Learning through doing We welcome people from diverse backgrounds. What matters most is the quality of your work, taking ownership, and helping the business move forward. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

data.title: Senior Financial Controller
data.description: MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken. Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie. Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie. MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als collega bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 250 professionals uit meer dan 40 nationaliteiten. Verantwoordelijkheden Project Control Samenwerken met Project Managers bij het opstellen en beoordelen van projectbudgetten, fee-calculaties en forecasts. Financiële projectprestaties monitoren, waaronder omzet, kosten, marge, WIP en cashflow, en risico's en kansen tijdig signaleren. Variantie- en scenarioanalyses uitvoeren en de resultaten vertalen naar praktisch advies over winstgevendheid, facturatie en cashflow. Project Managers ondersteunen bij projectopstart, maandelijkse reviews en projectafsluiting. Zorgen voor een correcte projectopzet, coderingsstructuren en kostentoewijzingen. Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie. Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering. Financial Control Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen. Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces. Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting. Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie. Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages. Business Control & Business Partnering Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning. Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses. Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie. Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning. Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's. Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming. Wie zoeken wij? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar. Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen financial control, business control, accountancy of een vergelijkbare financiële functie. Aantoonbare ervaring met jaarafsluitingen, financiële verslaggeving en jaarrekeningen. Ervaring met accountantscontroles en samenwerking met externe accountants. Ervaring binnen een projectgedreven organisatie, bij voorkeur in architectuur, engineering, consultancy of een vergelijkbare omgeving. Een sterk begrip van financiële rapportage, project accounting en interne beheersing. Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met ERP- en BI-tools. Vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré. Analytisch, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht. In staat financiële vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-financiële stakeholders. Proactief, zelfstandig en gericht op verbetering. Wat bieden wij? Bij MVRDV krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een internationaal, creatief en ondernemend bureau. Je werkt nauw samen met Project Managers, Directors en Financeteam van 5 collega’s en speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van onze organisatie. Wij bieden je: Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Een internationale werkomgeving met collega's en projecten over de hele wereld. Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Een marktconform salaris conform de cao Architectenbureaus, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring. 30 vakantiedagen, hybride werken en een inspirerende werkplek in Rotterdam. Onbeperkte toegang tot OpenUp, korting met Urban Sports, een gezonde lunch geserveerd, een NS Business Card en een laptop. Klaar om mee te bouwen aan een financieel sterke toekomst voor MVRDV? We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

data.title: Full Stack Engineer
data.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API. Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam. What you'll do in this role Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability. Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly. Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer. Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns. Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance. Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack. Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices. What you bring to the table 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering. Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML. Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail. Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply. Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries. Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level. Experience with containerised workflows using Docker. Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively. Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow. Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features. What success in the first 6 months looks like You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts. You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer. You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue. You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks. You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant. You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you. Current tech stack We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach. Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns. What we offer: Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company. Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. Hybrid working model. Policies to support working parents. Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office. Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! data.description: About the role Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar sparren met het social team vind je net zo leuk. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als in schrift. Mission of this role Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct. Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there. Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there. What you'll do Own Transport end to end: Running the full release train for your value stream: discovery, scoping, design, development, launch and post-launch tracking. Run customer discovery yourself, in the field: Talk to rental companies about how they plan, staff and execute transport today: warehouse-to-venue routing, multi-stop and multi-vehicle loads, load order, crew and vehicle capacity, and the constraints that make equipment transport harder than generic delivery routing. Define the first sellable increment. Find the smallest thing customers will genuinely pay for, ship it, and be able to explain why that slice was the right first bet. Build and own a sequenced, evidence-based roadmap with the Head of Product, aligned to company goals and product strategy. And explain the prioritisation to sales, support and management so they can plan against it. Translate routing and logistics complexity into buildable scope: multi-stop optimisation, time windows, vehicle and crew capacity, mapping and routing APIs, and the build-vs-buy decisions that come with them. Define success before you build it: Every feature carries a business goal, product briefs stay current, a live dashboard goes up at launch, and you drive go-to-market together with Product Marketing, Support, Sales and Content & Community. What we are looking for 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS. You've owned a product area end to end. From discovery through launch and post-launch tracking, not a backlog-only PO role. You're comfortable with operationally complex problems: routing, scheduling, fleet or capacity planning, supply chain, field service. A logistics background is a plus, not a must. You work from data. You can show how you set a success metric, what you did when it was missed, and how you make the business case behind a product call. You've run customer discovery yourself, not through a research team, and you can make and defend scope calls on partial evidence. Nice to haves Product experience in route optimisation, fleet management, field service or supply chain / TMS, or hands-on experience with mapping and routing APIs and platforms (Google Maps Platform, HERE, Mapbox, route-optimisation engines). Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role As a Product Marketing Manager, you drive revenue by leading the go-to-market of Rentman's new features, products and add-ons. You position each one so new customers buy in and existing customers add it to what they already use. Without this role, no one leads the cross-functional push that grows revenue from both new and existing customers. What you'll do Develop and refine Rentman’s messaging and positioning to clearly communicate the value of our products to key customer segments Build a strong understanding of customer needs, pain points, and decision-making processes across our key markets and industries and educate other departments on the findings Identify the user value of new features, craft impactful messaging, and execute feature and product launches to drive awareness and adoption Lead product marketing content development, creating compelling and persuasive content to support product positioning, feature launches, and customer engagement Support our go-to-market (GTM) product initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure effective product positioning and rollout strategies Keep all product documentation (internal and external) up to date, ensuring clear value propositions that align with brand standards What we are looking for 3+ years product marketing experience owning positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for product or feature launches (B2B SaaS preferred) You can point to specific launches they led and the adoption or revenue result Strong written communication: clear, jargon-free messaging for varied audiences Comfortable using product usage data (e.g. Mixpanel) to define and track whether a launch worked Worked cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Customer Success Nice to haves Experience marketing monetized add-ons or features (expansion, not just adoption) Familiarity with the events/media production/rental industry, or a comparable vertical SaaS Experience in vertical B2B SaaS Experience in Product-Led Growth (PLG) companies Tools: HubSpot, Mixpanel, Appcues, Chameleon, Klue, Google Analytics What you’ll get Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary) 25 vacation days to recharge Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years. A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year Pension plan through BrightPensioen An annual training budget to grow your skills Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17 Our process Here's a breakdown of our recruitment process to give you a clear idea: Call with recruiter about the role (30 mins) Past experience & culture interview (60 mins) Take-home assignment (max 120 mins) Skill interview with assignment presentation (60 mins) Final skills interview at our office with your future manager (45 mins) Apply now! For questions or additional information, contact us at At Rentman, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe that our differences make us stronger and strive to foster a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

data.title: Network Engineer
data.description: About the role Help build the networks connecting SkyNRG’s offices and future production sites! As we scale Sustainable Aviation Fuel production, secure and reliable connectivity between our IT and operational environments becomes increasingly critical. We are looking for a Network Engineer (IT/OT) to design, build, and operate the network architecture supporting our Amsterdam headquarters, first production facility, and future sites. This is a hands-on role with real influence over how our network landscape develops, from routing, switching and Wi-Fi to firewalls, IT/OT segmentation, and secure remote access. Reporting to the IT Operations & Infrastructure Manager, the role works closely with IT, security, plant engineering, and automation partners. Your Responsibilities: Design, build, and operate IT and OT network infrastructure at headquarters and production sites, from Purdue Level 3 upward and at the boundary with plant control systems Manage and optimize our Fortinet (IT) and Palo Alto (OT) firewall environments, including rule sets, segmentation, and the industrial DMZ Operate Cisco Catalyst switching and Meraki wireless at our production sites, alongside the office network at headquarters Implement and maintain secure remote access for employees and vendors, including zero trust access Deploy and operate Nozomi Networks for OT asset visibility and threat detection, and integrate network and OT logs into our SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) Support incident response together with our security team and managed SOC provider, and contribute to NIS2 compliance activities This is an opportunity to build an IT/OT network from the ground up rather than maintain a legacy landscape. You will work with a modern technology stack, have real influence over architecture decisions, and see the direct impact of your work on our operational reliability and cybersecurity maturity. The position is based at our headquarters in Amsterdam. Expect regular travel to the production site during construction and commissioning, becoming occasional once the site is in operation. Your profile As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing. You recognize yourself in the following: 5+ years of experience as a Network Engineer, including hands-on responsibility for enterprise firewall environments Strong experience with Fortinet FortiGate or Palo Alto Networks firewalls, and the willingness to master the other Solid knowledge of routing, switching (preferably Cisco Catalyst), wireless, VPN technologies, and network security best practices Experience with, or strong knowledge of, OT and industrial network environments, including ICS and SCADA systems Understanding of IT/OT segmentation principles and frameworks such as IEC 62443 and the Purdue Model, including industrial DMZ design Experience with OT monitoring solutions, preferably Nozomi Networks or comparable platforms such as Claroty or Dragos Comfortable working in both office and plant environments, including regular travel to production sites Professional proficiency in English Nice-to-haves: Certifications such as Fortinet FCP (NSE 4+), Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, Cisco CCNP, Nozomi Networks, IEC 62443, or GICSP Experience within the process industry, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, or another industrial environment Familiarity with NIS2 and experience translating regulatory requirements into practical technical controls Experience with zero trust network access (such as Zscaler) and Microsoft Azure networking Experience integrating network and OT logs into a SIEM, preferably Microsoft Sentinel Automation or scripting experience with Python or Ansible, and Git-based workflows Experience working with EPC contractors or automation vendors during plant construction and commissioning Dutch language skills About SkyNRG Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards. At SkyNRG, you’ll find: An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF What we offer We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet. Besides that, we offer: 30 paid holidays + 2 for choosing sustainable travel options for your holidays Contribute to a sustainable organization (B Corp) Attractive bonus scheme €5.000,- dedicated budget every 3 years for professional development Commuting travel reimbursement + Lease a Bike plan An office in the city centre of Amsterdam (Nieuwmarkt) Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office) working arrangements Generous employer pension contribution Paid Volunteering Day Access to our electric company boat (also available for private use), free lunch, and lots of social activities – all part of the deal! Is this you? Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying. For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com . 📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services. At SkyNRG, we deeply value inclusion and diversity. data.title: Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01
data.description: Please note: For this role proficiency in both Dutch and English is required. Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01 As Reliability & Maintenance Engineer DSL-01, you are responsible for building and continuously improving the facility's maintenance, reliability, and asset integrity framework. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you help ensure the plant operates safely, reliably, and efficiently. The role starts with a strong Maintenance Engineering focus. Your priority will be to help establish the maintenance and reliability foundation of DSL-01 by answering a fundamental question: "how do we maintain our assets safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their lifecycle?" You will translate reliability studies, equipment criticality assessments, and integrity requirements into practical maintenance plans, inspection programmes, spare parts strategies, and asset management processes. As the facility moves into stable operations, the focus gradually shifts towards Reliability Engineering, where you will use asset health monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent failures and improve long-term asset performance. Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external specialists, you will help reduce technical risk and improve asset reliability from day one. You will: Develop and continuously improve maintenance, inspection, and asset integrity strategies Translate reliability studies, FMECA analyses, and engineering data into practical maintenance plans within the CMMS/EAM system Act as owner of the asset register from a maintenance, reliability, and integrity perspective Support the implementation and continuous development of the facility's CMMS/EAM system Drive reliability improvements through asset health monitoring, KPI analysis, and predictive maintenance techniques Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective actions Monitor and improve reliability performance indicators such as MTBF, MTTR, availability, and inspection compliance Support asset improvement, modification, and long-term replacement strategies throughout the asset lifecycle Your profile As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and enjoys turning complex technical challenges into practical solutions. You recognize yourself in the following: Must have Fluent in Dutch and English Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline (i.e. electrical or mechanical) 5+ years of experience in Reliability Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, Asset Integrity, or Asset Management Experience with RCM, FMEA/FMECA, RCA, and maintenance strategy development Experience with CMMS/EAM systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or IFS Preferred Experience in chemical, petrochemical, energy, or other process industries like food or FMCG Experience with CMMS/EAM implementation or optimisation Experience with predictive maintenance and condition monitoring Knowledge of ATEX, PED, and asset integrity management About DSL-01 DSL-01 is SkyNRG’s frontrunning renewable fuels facility in Delfzijl, Netherlands. The plant will produce Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) from residual fats and greases using the HEFA (Hydrotreated Esters and Fatty Acids) pathway, with additional renewable products like butane, propane, and naphtha as by-products. DSL-01 is the first facility in Europe dedicated entirely to SAF and its by-products. Once operational, it will produce 100,000 tonnes of SAF and 35,000 tonnes of sustainable by-products per year, cutting greenhouse gas emissions by around 80% compared to conventional jet fuel. Construction started in 2026, with first fuel expected in 2028. The project includes the main facility, pipelines, and temporary work areas. At DSL-01, you will be part of a team building a state-of-the-art industrial plant from the ground up, contributing to a truly sustainable energy future. Environmental and social responsibility are at the heart of DSL-01. We follow international frameworks and Dutch regulations to manage impacts on people, nature, and local communities. Safety, sustainability, and collaboration guide everything we do. What we offer As DSL-01 is still being built, many aspects of the plant, roles, and benefits are still being shaped. Our HR team is actively defining the full compensation and benefits package specifically for the Delfzijl facility. You can be assured that the final offer will be highly competitive and designed to reward your expertise, contribution, and impact as we bring this pioneering SAF plant to life. We are committed to offering an attractive total package to ensure we attract the best talent in the market. This includes a competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and a range of benefits that support your personal and professional growth. Is this you? At DSL-01, you will work in a dynamic, innovative environment where technical curiosity, problem-solving, and teamwork are valued. You will engage with operators, engineers, and managers across disciplines, helping to bring a pioneering renewable fuels facility to life while making a real impact on the planet. Are you ready to help build a plant from the ground up? Join a pioneering force in sustainable aviation and help create a cleaner, more sustainable future. data.title: Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01
data.description: Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01 Werk mee aan een van de eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken in Europa. Je draagt bij aan de bouw van DSL-01 in Delfzijl: een fabriek gericht op de productie van Sustainable Aviation Fuel en bijproducten. Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren team waarin jouw expertise direct bijdraagt aan een veilige en succesvolle realisatie van het project. Over de functie Als Supply Chain Planner krijg je de kans om vanaf de basis mee te bouwen aan de supply chain van DSL-01. Jouw werk helpt de basis te leggen voor een betrouwbare operatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige productiefaciliteiten voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). Je stapt op een uniek moment in een groeiende organisatie. Voor de start van de fabriek: Help je mee de supply chain-organisatie van DSL-01 op te bouwen, inclusief de processen, systemen en werkwijzen die nodig zijn voor operational readiness. Draag je bij aan de inrichting van ERP-systemen, supply chain-processen en de voorbereiding van een veilige, betrouwbare en efficiënte operatie. Na de start van de fabriek: Speel je een belangrijke rol in de dagelijkse supply chain-operatie, van grondstoffen- en productieplanning tot afstemming met leveranciers en afnemers. Zorg je samen met interne en externe stakeholders voor een stabiele supply chain die een veilige en continue productie ondersteunt. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van productie-, supply- en offtakeplanningen voor de korte, middellange en lange termijn. Vertalen van productiebehoeften naar materiaalvereisten en afstemmen van beschikbaarheid met leveranciers, Procurement en sourcing-teams. Coördineren van planning tussen Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Procurement en commerciële stakeholders. Signaleren van risico's, verstoringen en capaciteitsbeperkingen en ontwikkelen van passende scenario's en oplossingen. Leveren van analyses en inzichten ter ondersteuning van het Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)-proces. Actief bijdragen aan de inrichting, validatie en optimalisatie van ERP-systemen en supply chain-processen. Ondersteunen van processen rondom traceability, certificering en mass balancing. Initiëren en leiden van verbeteringen op het gebied van planning, systemen en werkwijzen. Fungeren als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor complexe planningsvraagstukken tijdens operational readiness en de opstart van de fabriek. Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van operationele verantwoordelijkheid en de kans om een nieuwe supply chain-organisatie mee vorm te geven. Jouw profiel Je bent analytisch sterk, neemt eigenaarschap en voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Je bent in staat verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer informatie beperkt of onvolledig is. Wat breng je mee? HBO werk- en denkniveau. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Supply Planner, Production Planner, Material Planner of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een productieomgeving. Een sterk begrip van supply chain-processen en ERP-systemen. Uitstekende analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om inzichten te vertalen naar acties en besluitvorming. Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte houding en een sterk gevoel van eigenaarschap. Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement in een complexe operationele omgeving. Het vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen onder onzekerheid. Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels. Additionele vaardigheden/ervaring Ervaring binnen de proces- en maakindustrie. Ervaring met ERP-implementaties, systeeminrichting of user acceptance testing. Ervaring met het opstarten van nieuwe productielocaties of operationele organisaties. Kennis van traceability, certificering, mass balancing, dangerous goods of waste management. Over DSL-01 In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta. DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten. De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart. We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Wat wij bieden DSL-01 is volop in ontwikkeling. Dat geldt niet alleen voor de fabriek, maar ook voor de organisatie en de arbeidsvoorwaarden. Ons HR-team werkt aan een passend en marktconform pakket voor de locatie in Delfzijl. Je kunt rekenen op een goed salaris, een bonusregeling en arbeidsvoorwaarden die ruimte bieden voor jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Solliciteer Wil jij meebouwen aan een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart. Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com & www.DSL-01.com 📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. SkyNRG / DSL-01 is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken. data.title: HSE Specialist | DSL-01
data.description: HSE Specialist | DSL-01 Werk mee aan een van de eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken in Europa. Je draagt bij aan de bouw van DSL-01 in Delfzijl: een fabriek gericht op de productie van Sustainable Aviation Fuel en bijproducten. Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren team waarin jouw expertise direct bijdraagt aan een veilige en succesvolle realisatie van het project. Over de functie Als HSE Specialist speel je een belangrijke rol in het veilig voorbereiden van een nieuwe chemische procesinstallatie op ingebruikname. Je werkt nauw samen met engineers, projectteams, contractors en toekomstige operations collega's om de processen, systemen en veiligheidsmaatregelen te ontwikkelen die nodig zijn voor een veilige opstart en bedrijfsvoering van DSL-01. DSL-01 bevindt zich in de overgang van projectuitvoering naar operationele gereedheid. Om een veilige opstart en succesvolle lange termijn exploitatie mogelijk te maken, moeten alle benodigde QHSES-processen, procedures, systemen en tools worden ontwikkeld, geïmplementeerd en geborgd binnen de organisatie. In deze functie ondersteun je de QHSES Manager bij het realiseren van deze ambitie en draag je bij aan naleving van wet- en regelgeving, vergunningseisen, ISO-normen en interne bedrijfsstandaarden. Neemt bij afwezigheid van de QHSES Manager aangewezen QHSES-taken over en ziet toe op de naleving van veiligheidsvoorschriften, procedures en wettelijke verplichtingen om een veilige werkomgeving te waarborgen. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden: QHSES-managementsysteem & compliance: Ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling, implementatie en continue verbetering van het DSL-01 Integrated Management System en bijdragen aan naleving van bedrijfsstandaarden, wet- en regelgeving en best practices binnen de industrie. Vergunningen & wettelijke naleving: Ondersteunen bij milieuvergunningen, vergunning s wijzigingen, compliance-monitoring en het beheer van wettelijke registers, waaronder REACH-gerelateerde verplichtingen. Risicomanagement & assurance: Ondersteunen bij proces- en veiligheidsrisicoanalyses, zoals HAZID-, HAZOP- en RI&E-trajecten, het beheren van risicoregisters en het ondersteunen van audits, inspecties en incidentonderzoeken om risico's binnen een industriële procesomgeving te beheersen. Documentatie, training & operationele gereedheid: Opstellen, beheren en onderhouden van procedures, werkinstructies, trainingsvereisten en overige QHSES-documentatie om de organisatie voor te bereiden op veilige en conforme bedrijfsvoering. Stakeholder- & projectondersteuning: Fungeren als verbindende schakel tussen de corporate QHSES-organisatie en het DSL-01-projectteam en bijdragen aan certificeringstrajecten, occupational health-programma's en de succesvolle implementatie van QHSES-initiatieven. Jouw profiel We zijn een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende: Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Je beschikt over een MBO+/HBO-opleiding in Veiligheidskunde, Milieukunde, Techniek, Integrale Veiligheidskunde of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Health, Safety, Environment of QHSES-gerelateerde functies. Je hebt ervaring in een industriële, chemische, productie-, energie- of andere hoog-risico omgeving. Je hebt een goed begrip van arbeidsveiligheidswetgeving, risicomanagement en compliance vereisten. Je hebt ervaring met ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 en/of Seveso/BRZO-gerelateerde kaders. Je bent bekend met risicogestuurd werken en continu verbeteren. Je hebt ervaring met RI&E-processen en risicoregisters. Je beschikt over sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en werkt nauwkeurig met documentatie en systemen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta. DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. data.title: OT Engineer | DSL-01
data.description: OT Engineer | DSL-01 Werk mee aan een van de eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken in Europa. data.title: Stage: Optimalisatie van Rapportages
data.description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen onze organisatie speelt planning een belangrijke rol in het realiseren van projecten, het optimaal benutten van capaciteit en het bewaken van voortgang. data.description: (FEQ128R42) The Role You will be the technical leader and lead architect for one of Databricks' most strategic global customers: a health technology company whose diagnostic, therapy, connected-care and consumer health products reach hundreds of millions of people every year. Experience designing validated, audit-ready (GxP / 21 CFR Part 11) data and AI environments. Enterprise-scale SAP data integration (BW, S/4HANA) and semantic harmonisation. data.title: System Architect
data.description: Are you an experienced System Architect with a passion for intelligent building management systems, industrial automation, and safety-critical applications? At Deerns, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative and challenging projects that contribute to a smarter, safer, and more sustainable future. Read on and discover how you can make an impact. The challenge The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes. This position involves developing safe, efficient, and future-ready systems that connect various installations, such as HVAC, lighting, access control, gas safety, and industrial process control. You will work closely with project teams, suppliers, and end-users to create innovative and sustainable solutions that meet the highest safety standards. Your responsibilities include: Developing automation architectures: Design scalable solutions for intelligent building management and process automation, including gas detection systems, safety mechanisms, and process control. System integration: Connect installations using protocols like BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and industrial standards such as OPC UA and PROFIBUS. Gas safety and process safety: Develop solutions for gas detection, emergency shutdowns, ventilation integration, and fail-safe control systems for industrial environments. Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations. Process optimization: Analyze and optimize industrial processes and systems to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability. Stakeholder management: Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including clients, end-users, engineers, and project managers, ensuring solutions meet both functional and technical requirements. Continuous learning and development: Stay updated on the latest innovations in smart technologies and automation, applying these to develop improved, future-proof solutions. • Technological consulting: Identify innovations to enhance performance and reliability in intelligent buildings and industrial environments. Documentation and communication: Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. Required Skills and Competencies: Extensive knowledge of intelligent building management solutions, gas safety systems, and industrial process control. Expertise in communication standards and protocols such as KNX, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, and PROFIBUS. Proficiency in designing fail-safe systems and safety-critical applications. Experience with IT networks and cybersecurity in automation environments. Strong analytical skills and problem-solving abilities. Flexibility and the ability to continuously adapt to technological advancements. Excellent communication skills to clearly present complex technical issues Education and Experience: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Technology, or a related field. Relevant experience in intelligent building management solutions, industrial automation, and safety-critical systems. This role combines technological innovation with safety-critical applications. As a System Architect, you will develop integrated solutions that maximize comfort, safety, efficiency, and sustainability in both buildings and industrial processes. We offer A position of 32-40 hours per week with a salary to match. Challenging projects for leading clients in the Netherlands and internationally. A work environment in which innovation and sustainability are put into practice daily. Attention to your own development and vitality with ample training and development opportunities, bicycle and sports arrangements, flexible working hours, 33 vacation days and the possibility of purchasing additional days. Hybrid working, where you have the opportunity to alternate between working from home and the office. A team where cooperation and collegiality are priority, and where we interact informally. Sustainability is in our genes. This is expressed, for example, in a mobility policy where health and sustainability are most important. Many of our offices are located near public transport hubs, cycling is encouraged, and your travel expenses are reimbursed 100% on the basis of public transport. About Deerns As an independent engineering firm, Deerns specializes in consultancy, design and implementation supervision in the fields of installation engineering, building physics, energy supply and sustainability. Our areas of expertise contribute to sustainable, intelligent and future-proof buildings that optimally support our clients' processes. We are responsible for designing the installations and realizing good comfort and a pleasant climate in a wide variety of buildings; from offices, to airports and from hospitals to data centers. In addition, Deerns has been named a World Class Workplace for 2026! Want to know more? Would you like to know more about working at Deerns? data.title: Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen
data.description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. We groeien hard. Tot nu toe worden al onze warmtepompen geïnstalleerd door externe partners, maar daar komt verandering in. We gaan onze eigen installatieteams opbouwen en zoeken daarom een Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen die hierin het voortouw neemt. Je bent een ervaren monteur die graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt, maar ook energie krijgt van het begeleiden van anderen. Je gaat samen met je team op pad, bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de installaties en helpt ons om steeds meer monteurs op te leiden. Je komt dus niet in een bestaand team terecht. Je helpt het team zelf opbouwen. Wat ga je doen? Als Hoofdmonteur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie van onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis. Je begint met het leiden van ons eerste interne installatieteam en helpt ons om de komende jaren onze eigen installatiecapaciteit verder uit te bouwen. Je installeert warmtepompen en leidt je team Je gaat samen met een collega-monteur op pad om onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis te installeren. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige installatie, van de technische uitvoering en het oplossen van onverwachte problemen tot de oplevering. Je zorgt dat installaties veilig, efficiënt en volgens onze kwaliteitsstandaarden worden uitgevoerd. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor de klant tijdens de installatie. Je legt uit wat jullie doen, beantwoordt vragen en zorgt dat de klant met een goed gevoel achterblijft. Je stemt waar nodig af met onze werkvoorbereiders en collega's op kantoor over planning, materialen en technische uitdagingen. Je bouwt mee aan ons interne installatieteam Je begeleidt en traint nieuwe monteurs en helpt hen om zelfstandig installaties uit te kunnen voeren. Je denkt mee over het aannemen van nieuwe collega's en hoe we ons installatieteam verder kunnen uitbreiden. Je helpt onze installatiestandaarden en werkwijzen verder te ontwikkelen. Je signaleert wat er in de praktijk beter of slimmer kan en neemt initiatief om dit te verbeteren. Je deelt feedback vanuit het veld met onze engineers, werkvoorbereiders en productontwikkelaars, zodat we onze producten en installaties continu kunnen verbeteren. Wie zoeken wij? We zoeken iemand die zijn vak goed verstaat, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en het leuk vindt om anderen beter te maken. Je hoeft niet eerder een heel team te hebben opgebouwd, maar je moet wel zin hebben om die uitdaging aan te gaan. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het installeren van warmtepompen, cv-installaties of andere verwarmingssystemen. Ervaring met warmtepompen heeft een sterke voorkeur. Je hebt een goede technische basis in installatietechniek, elektrotechniek en/of werktuigbouwkunde. Je kunt zelfstandig installaties uitvoeren, technische tekeningen lezen en onverwachte problemen oplossen. Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van andere monteurs, of bent klaar om die verantwoordelijkheid op je te nemen. Je werkt nauwkeurig en veilig en vindt het belangrijk om goed werk af te leveren. Je communiceert makkelijk met klanten en collega's en kunt technische zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen. Je neemt initiatief, denkt in oplossingen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat. Je spreekt goed Nederlands en hebt rijbewijs B. Een relevante mbo-opleiding en certificeringen zoals VCA, NEN 3140 of CO-vakmanschap zijn mooi meegenomen. Heb je nog niet alle benodigde certificaten? Dan kijken we samen wat je nog kunt behalen. Wat bieden wij jou? Een salaris van €4.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Een sleutelrol in ons bedrijf: je wordt de eerste Hoofdmonteur van ons interne installatieteam en helpt dit verder uit te bouwen. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid: je krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we installeren, samenwerken en nieuwe monteurs opleiden. Goed materiaal: een volledig uitgeruste werkbus en professioneel gereedschap. 26 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen op basis van 40 uur, met de mogelijkheid om te kiezen voor een hogere beloning in plaats van ADV. Een goede pensioenregeling volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek. Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, zowel technisch als in het begeleiden en aansturen van een team. Een betrokken team met korte lijnen, weinig bureaucratie en regelmatig leuke activiteiten, van borrels en teamuitjes tot onze jaarlijkse wintersport. Waarom DeWarmte? Bij DeWarmte geloven we dat verduurzaming pas echt werkt als het voor iedereen bereikbaar en aantrekkelijk is. Daarom ontwikkelen we slimme, betaalbare warmtepompen die we zelf ontwerpen en assembleren. We zijn een groeiend bedrijf waar veel gebeurt en waar je echt invloed hebt op hoe we dingen aanpakken. We houden van mensen die initiatief nemen, samenwerken en niet wachten tot iemand anders een probleem oplost. Als Hoofdmonteur krijg je de kans om vanaf het begin mee te bouwen aan onze eigen installatieorganisatie. Je werkt zelf aan mooie technische installaties, leidt nieuwe monteurs op en helpt bepalen hoe we dit in de toekomst op grotere schaal gaan doen. Klaar om samen met ons iets op te bouwen? Solliciteer en kom kennismaken. We vertellen je graag meer over DeWarmte, onze warmtepompen en onze plannen voor het interne installatieteam. Compensation: €4K – €6K per month • €4K – €6K per month Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

data.title: PLC Software Engineer - The Netherlands
data.description: Ready to build the software behind real-world renewable energy installations? At Bright Renewables, your PLC software doesn’t stay behind a desk. You’ll see it come to life in complex industrial installations for renewable gas and CO₂ technologies. As a PLC Software Engineer , you’ll be involved in the complete automation lifecycle - from software design and programming to testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions, help shape our automation standards, and work alongside experienced colleagues as part of an international software engineering team of around 10 engineers. Together, you’ll collaborate across the Netherlands, Latvia, and Poland to develop and deliver reliable, innovative automation solutions. Why this role? You’ll get the opportunity to: Own your solutions - contribute to software solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from design and programming to testing and commissioning; Work on real installations - solve automation challenges in complex renewable energy plants; Have technical influence - contribute to software standards, templates, concepts, and ways of working, within a team that values collaboration and embraces innovative ideas from everyone; Keep developing - work alongside experienced Electrical and Software Engineers and continue building your technical expertise; Work internationally - collaborate with colleagues and project teams in the Netherlands, Poland, Latvia and beyond, including regular international travel to visit our offices and project sites; Choose what works for you - work 32 or 40 hours per week, with flexible starting times and opportunities to work from home; Make an impact - use your automation expertise in technologies that contribute directly to the energy transition. What will you do? As a PLC Software Engineer, you design, develop, test, and commission PLC and SCADA control systems for technologies such as gas upgrading and CO₂ liquefaction. You report directly to the Manager E&I and Software and work closely with Electrical Engineers, Process Engineers and fellow Software Engineers . Depending on your experience, you’ll also have the opportunity to take more technical ownership, contribute to software concepts and standards, and support colleagues with complex automation challenges. Your responsibilities include: Designing, programming, testing, and commissioning PLC and SCADA systems ; Developing control software for gas upgrading, CO₂ liquefaction, and other renewable energy technologies; Taking ownership of your software from engineering through commissioning; Testing and troubleshooting software during commissioning and operation; Analyzing and resolving software and control-related issues in existing installations; Implementing software updates and optimizations; Supporting Service Engineers with more complex automation and software questions; Contributing to software standards, templates, and automation concepts; Working closely with Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, and other technical disciplines; Sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues within the engineering team. What do you bring? We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to take responsibility for their own engineering work. Ideally, you have: A completed technical education in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field; Several years of experience in PLC/SCADA engineering within an industrial environment; Hands-on experience in PLC programming, ideally with Siemens S7 and TIA Portal, combined with knowledge of WinCC SCADA, industrial communication networks, and remote access solutions. Experience with commissioning and troubleshooting industrial installations; A good understanding of automation architectures and industrial control systems; Good command of English, both spoken and written; Knowledge of OT security is a plus. What’s in it for you? We want to give you the technical freedom and working environment to do your best engineering work. You can expect: A competitive salary based on your experience and technical background; The option to work 32 or 40 hours per week; Flexible starting times between 7:00 and 9:00 a.m. ; Ample opportunities to work from home, including a one-time €250 allowance to set up your home office; An attractive annual profit-sharing scheme for employees with at least 12 months of service; An excellent pension scheme; 8% annual holiday allowance; A commuting allowance of €0.23 per kilometer, in accordance with our employment conditions; A high level of autonomy and responsibility; Plenty of opportunities for technical and professional development; An international engineering environment with both experienced professionals and engineers earlier in their careers; The opportunity to work with renewable energy technologies and contribute directly to the energy transition; A bike lease program and rewards for cycling to work; A modern, sustainably built working environment in Hengelo. About Bright Renewables Bright Renewables develops and delivers technologies for renewable gas and CO₂ capture, providing solutions from engineering and realization through to service and maintenance. Our installations convert biogas into renewable natural gas and capture, purify, and liquefy CO₂ for industrial reuse. We are part of HoSt Group , a family-owned Dutch company operating internationally in renewable energy technology. For you, that means working on international projects with the opportunities of a global organization, while keeping the short communication lines, technical freedom, and personal approach of a family-owned company. Interested? We’d like to get to know you. Apply by submitting your CV and motivation through the application button. Within 14 days, we’ll let you know whether we’d like to invite you for an interview. Would you first like to know more about the technology, team, or day-to-day work? Contact Wybren Broersma, Manager E&I and Software, or Natalia Wisniewska, Corporate Recruiter, at +31 88 460 90 80. Build software. See it running. Make an impact on renewable energy.
